trans-unit.source: Arc accordion: a list of question rows that reveal their answers in place. The panel height follows the content on a smooth spring that never overshoots and retargets mid-flight, the answer settles down 6px out of a subtle blur as it opens, and the chevron turns on a snappy spring. Single mode (Arc) keeps one row open and lets it close; `Multiple` opens rows independently. Arrow keys move between the row triggers, Home / End jump to the ends, Enter / Space toggle. Rows are `AccordionItem`s written inline (`<arc:AccordionItem Header="Question">Answer</arc:AccordionItem>`) or generated from `ItemsSource` (`ItemTemplate` renders the question, `ContentTemplate` the answer).
trans-unit.target: Arc 手風琴：一組問題列，展開後在原位顯示答案。面板高度沿平滑彈簧跟隨內容變化，不會過衝，並且可以在動畫中途改變目標；答案展開時從輕微模糊中下落 6px；箭頭以靈敏的彈簧轉動。單選模式（Arc）保持一列展開，並允許其收合；`Multiple` 則讓各列獨立展開。方向鍵在列觸發器之間移動，Home / End 跳到首尾，Enter / Space 切換展開。列為內嵌寫入的 `AccordionItem`（`<arc:AccordionItem Header="Question">Answer</arc:AccordionItem>`），或由 `ItemsSource` 產生（`ItemTemplate` 渲染問題，`ContentTemplate` 渲染答案）。

trans-unit.source: Template for the answers of data items (the question uses `ItemTemplate`).
trans-unit.target: 資料項答案的範本（問題使用 `ItemTemplate`）。

trans-unit.source: Single (Arc) or multiple open rows.
trans-unit.target: 單選（Arc）或多列同時展開。

trans-unit.source: Index of the open row; −1 closes every row (Arc defaultOpen, default 0). Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 已展開列的索引；−1 表示收合所有列（Arc 的 defaultOpen 預設為 0）。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Row size; `Large` suits page-level FAQs.
trans-unit.target: 列的尺寸；`Large` 適合頁面層級的常見問題。

trans-unit.source: One row of an `Accordion`: `Header` is the question (the whole row is the trigger) and `Content` the answer. The answer stays mounted while closed so a second click mid-flight reverses from where it is; a closed answer takes no pointer or keyboard focus.
trans-unit.target: `Accordion` 的一列：`Header` 為問題（整列即觸發器），`Content` 為答案。收合時答案仍保持掛載，因此動畫中途再次點擊會從目前位置反向；收合的答案不接收指標或鍵盤焦點。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the row opens or closes.
trans-unit.target: 列展開或收合後引發。

trans-unit.source: Whether the answer is open. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 答案是否展開。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: A call to action for one asynchronous submit (Save, Publish): pending and success show on the button itself. The changed letters of the label rise out of a soft blur while kept letters glide (P4) and the width follows on a spring (P5); the trailing arrow leaves in the direction of the action, a spinner turns while `AsyncAction` runs, a check draws itself on success (P15), and the button returns to idle after `ResetAfter`. Pending keeps keyboard focus: activation is swallowed instead of disabling the button.
trans-unit.target: 用於一次非同步提交的行動按鈕（儲存、發布）：等待與成功狀態直接顯示在按鈕上。標籤中變化的字母從柔和模糊中升起，未變化的字母平滑滑動（P4），寬度沿彈簧跟隨變化（P5）；末尾箭頭朝操作方向離開，`AsyncAction` 執行時載入圖示旋轉，成功時勾號自行繪製（P15），並在 `ResetAfter` 之後恢復閒置狀態。等待期間保持鍵盤焦點：啟動操作會被忽略，而不是停用按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `AsyncAction` throws.
trans-unit.target: `AsyncAction` 擲出例外時引發。

trans-unit.source: The work to run. The button is pending until the task completes; a fault returns it to idle and raises `ActionFailed`. `Command` and `Click` run first and, without an async action, count as an immediate success.
trans-unit.target: 要執行的工作。在工作完成前按鈕處於等待狀態；發生錯誤會使其恢復閒置並引發 `ActionFailed`。`Command` 與 `Click` 會先執行，若沒有非同步操作，則視為立即成功。

trans-unit.source: The idle label and, always, the accessible name (default "Save").
trans-unit.target: 閒置時的標籤，同時始終作為無障礙名稱（預設為「儲存」）。

trans-unit.source: Shown while `AsyncAction` runs (default "Saving").
trans-unit.target: `AsyncAction` 執行期間顯示的標籤（預設為「儲存中」）。

trans-unit.source: How long success stays before returning to idle (default 2.4s); zero keeps it.
trans-unit.target: 成功狀態保持多久後恢復閒置（預設 2.4s）；設為零則一直保持。

trans-unit.source: Current phase: Idle, Pending while AsyncAction runs, or Success after it completes. Read-only.
trans-unit.target: 目前階段：Idle、AsyncAction 執行期間的 Pending，或完成後的 Success。唯讀。

trans-unit.source: Shown after the action succeeds (default "Saved").
trans-unit.target: 操作成功後顯示的標籤（預設為「已儲存」）。

trans-unit.source: Draws a row of icon buttons in the cell, such as Edit and Delete at the end of a row. A click runs the action's `Command` with the row object and raises `CellInvoked` with the action's label as the part; the cell is not selected by that click.
trans-unit.target: 在儲存格中畫一排圖示按鈕，例如列尾的編輯和刪除。點擊會帶著該列物件執行動作的 `Command`，並以動作的標籤作為部分名稱觸發 `CellInvoked`；該次點擊不會選取儲存格。

trans-unit.source: One day of an `ActivityHeatmap`.
trans-unit.target: `ActivityHeatmap` 中的一天。

trans-unit.source: A contribution-style calendar (Arc "Activity heatmap"): one square per day, weeks as columns, four accent tints for how busy a day was. Cells wave in once on first view; a single tooltip glides between cells on hover or keyboard focus; a new range recolors the grid in a diagonal sweep instead of redrawing it; the legend previews (hover, focus) or pins (click) one level. ↑ / ↓ move by day, ← / → by week, Home / End to the ends, Enter / Space select.
trans-unit.target: 貢獻式日曆（Arc “Activity heatmap”）：每天一個方塊，週為欄，四種強調色深淺表示當天的活躍程度。儲存格在首次顯示時依序浮入；單一提示框在滑鼠懸停或鍵盤焦點變化時在儲存格之間平滑滑動；切換範圍時以對角掃過的方式重新著色，而不是整體重繪；圖例在懸停、焦點時預覽某一級別，點選時鎖定該級別。↑ / ↓ 按天移動，← / → 按週移動，Home / End 跳到首尾，Enter / Space 選取。

trans-unit.source: A week of hourly activity as a terrain: 7 × 24 bars standing on a floor in perspective, as tall and as dark as each hour was busy. Drag to orbit, Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or pinch to zoom, hover a bar for its numbers and the day's shape, click it to fly the camera there; switch the metric and the bars rise to the new values in a diagonal wave; switch to the heat map and they press flat. Under the plot, a legend and a summary: the week's total and its change, the peak hours (each flies to its hour) and the busiest day.
trans-unit.target: 一週的每小時活動以地形圖呈現：7 × 24 根柱子立在透視的底面上，每個小時越繁忙，柱子就越高、顏色越深。拖曳可環繞，Ctrl/⌘ + 滾輪或捏合可縮放，懸停柱子可查看其數值和當天的走勢，點選則將相機飛到該處；切換指標時，柱子會沿對角線波浪式升至新數值；切換到熱力圖時，柱子則壓平。圖下方有圖例和摘要：本週總量及其變化、高峰時段（點選各項會飛到對應時刻）以及最忙的一天。

trans-unit.source: The busiest day's line: {0} is its total, {1} the unit, {2} the week's working-hours share (both numbers roll). Default "{0} {1}, {2} during working hours".
trans-unit.target: 最忙那天的一行文字：{0} 為其總量，{1} 為單位，{2} 為本週工作時間所佔的比例（兩個數字都會滾動變化）。預設 "{0} {1}, {2} during working hours"。

trans-unit.source: The title of the busiest day. Default "Busiest day".
trans-unit.target: 最忙那天的標題。預設 "Busiest day"。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the camera flies to an hour, or returns to the whole week (cell null).

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of the agent loop: a bright head with a gradient trail circles a ring past three stations (Gather context, Take action, Verify) around the model. At Gather a context block joins the stack beside the ring and the token total counts up; at Take action one to three tool calls drop out of the ring on a pin and resolve; at Verify a check passes or sends the loop round again. The run ends done (the ring draws in, a check at the center, the summary as the caption) or stopped when the last check fails. Play, pause, step, restart and a 0.5× / 1× / 2× speed control drive it; under reduced motion it opens on its end. The run is sample data: nothing calls a real service.
trans-unit.target: 代理循環的動畫講解：一個明亮的光點帶著漸層拖尾繞環而行，依序經過三個站點（收集上下文、執行動作、驗證）環繞模型。在收集上下文時，一個上下文區塊加入環旁的堆疊，token 總數逐步增加；在執行動作時，一到三個工具呼叫經由圖釘從環中落下並完成；在驗證時，檢查通過，或讓循環再次運行。運行結束時顯示完成（環線繪製收攏，中心出現勾號，摘要作為說明）或在最後一次檢查失敗時停止。播放、暫停、單步、重新開始以及 0.5×/1×/2× 速度控制項驅動演示；在減少動態效果下直接開啟結束狀態。此運行使用範例資料，不呼叫任何真實服務。

trans-unit.source: One pass round the loop: the context gathered, one to three tool calls made one after another, and the check. Calls are its content in XAML. Calls past the third are ignored; a loop with none still stops at Take action for the time of one call, with nothing dropping into the lane.

trans-unit.source: A card that shows what an assistant remembers about the person: a capacity meter, two switches (use saved memories, use chat history), filter pills by group, a search, and the memories themselves, which can be edited in place or forgotten with a few seconds to undo. A memory the assistant has just noted shows as a pill that files it into its group, and a field at the bottom adds one by hand and sorts it into a group. Changes are applied to `Memories` and reported through `MemoryChanged`; set `CommitAsync` to save them somewhere first (a failure shows in place and rolls the change back).
trans-unit.target: 一張卡片，顯示助手對使用者記住的內容：一個容量計量條、兩個開關（使用已儲存的記憶、使用聊天記錄）、依分組篩選的膠囊、一個搜尋框，以及記憶本身；記憶可以原地編輯，或在幾秒內復原前遺忘。助手剛記下的一則記憶會顯示為一個膠囊，點擊即可將其歸入對應分組；卡片底部的欄位可手動新增一則記憶並將其分入某個分組。變更會套用到 `Memories`，並透過 `MemoryChanged` 回報；可先設定 `CommitAsync` 將變更儲存到別處（失敗時會在原位顯示，並復原該變更）。

trans-unit.target: 助手的名稱，用於副標題和開關的說明文字中。

trans-unit.source: A page that answers one question, written like an article: the reasoning first, then the sources as small cards, then the answer streamed in with headings, lists, a table, code and numbered citations. Pointing at a citation lights the sentence it supports and its source card; pointing at a card lights every sentence that cites it. Under the answer are actions (copy, answer again, rate, share, versions), the model line and related questions, and a box asks a follow-up. Asking again replaces the answer in place: this is one question at a time, not a conversation.
trans-unit.target: 一個回答單一問題的頁面，以文章的形式呈現：先是推理，然後是以小卡片呈現的來源，接著是串流輸出的回答，包含標題、清單、表格、程式碼和編號引用。指向某個引用時，會點亮它所支持的句子及其來源卡片；指向某張卡片時，會點亮所有引用它的句子。回答下方有動作（複製、重新回答、評分、分享、版本）、模型資訊列和相關問題，並有一個方塊可以追問。重新提問會在原處取代回答：這是一次只處理一個問題的頁面，而非對話。

trans-unit.source: A chat with an assistant: a title menu, a model button and a new chat button on top, a thread of turns in the middle and a message box at the bottom. Replies stream in as Markdown with collapsible reasoning, tool chips, numbered citations that preview their source, and actions to copy, retry, rate and switch between versions. Editing a message or retrying a reply makes a new version of the turn; the turns after it belong to the version they followed. The chat calls `Responder` to answer, shows what it sends as it arrives and lets the person stop a reply. Without a responder, a sent message only appears in the thread and raises `MessageSent`, and your code fills the `AiChatReply` itself.
trans-unit.target: 與助理的對話：頂部為標題選單、模型按鈕與新增對話按鈕，中間為輪次列表，底部為訊息輸入框。回覆以 Markdown 串流呈現，包含可摺疊的推理過程、工具標籤、可預覽來源的編號引用，以及複製、重試、評分和在版本間切換的操作。編輯訊息或重試回覆會為該輪次建立新版本；其後的輪次屬於它們所接續的版本。對話透過 `Responder` 作答，邊到達邊顯示其送出的內容，並允許使用者停止回覆。若沒有回應器，送出的訊息只會出現在列表中並引發 `MessageSent`，由你的程式碼自行填入 `AiChatReply`。

trans-unit.source: The file types that may be attached, in the syntax of `FileDropzone.Accept`; null accepts any.
trans-unit.target: 可附加的檔案類型，語法與 `FileDropzone.Accept` 相同；為 null 時接受任何類型。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses a citation or a source row; set `Handled` to open it yourself.
trans-unit.target: 使用者按下引用或來源列時引發；設定 `Handled` 以便由你自行開啟。

trans-unit.source: The width of the column of turns (760 by default); the thread is this plus 28 on each side.

trans-unit.source: Arc alert: a persistent message that helps people recover or continue. Keep one instance and change `Tone`, `Title` and the content to morph it between states: the icon pops into the new tone, new text rises out of a soft blur and the height springs to fit. Hiding it (`IsOpen`) collapses the height while it fades, so the content below closes the gap. A string `Content` is the description line; any other content is shown as is.
trans-unit.target: Arc 警示：持續顯示的訊息，協助使用者恢復或繼續操作。保持同一執行個體，改變 `Tone`、`Title` 和內容即可在各狀態間變形：圖示以彈出方式切換為新色調，新文字從柔和模糊中升起，高度以彈簧適配內容。隱藏（`IsOpen`）時高度在淡出的同時收縮，使下方內容填補空隙。字串類型的 `Content` 為描述行；其他類型的內容按原樣顯示。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a dismissed alert finished collapsing.
trans-unit.target: 已關閉的警示完成收縮後引發。

trans-unit.source: Shows the dismiss button. Dismissing collapses the alert, then raises `Dismissed`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示關閉按鈕。關閉時先收縮警示，然後引發 `Dismissed`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the alert is shown. Hiding collapses its height and fades it out. Two-way.

trans-unit.target: 色調（預設 `Info`）。

trans-unit.source: A number that rolls digit by digit like an odometer: only changed columns turn (in the direction the whole number moved), separators slide in and out, and the label crossfades with a short rise. With `AnimateOnView` every digit rolls up from zero the first time 60% of the counter is visible.
trans-unit.target: 一個像里程表一樣逐位滾動的數字：只有變化的位會轉動（轉動方向與整個數字的變化方向一致），分隔符滑入滑出，標籤以短促上升的方式交叉淡入。設定 `AnimateOnView` 後，計數器首次有 60% 可見時，每一位都會從零滾動上來。

trans-unit.source: Roll every digit up from zero the first time the counter scrolls into view.
trans-unit.target: 計數器首次捲動進入視野時，所有位從零滾動到目標值。

trans-unit.source: Digits after the decimal point (default 0); negative values count as 0.
trans-unit.target: 小數點後的位數（預設 0）；負值視為 0。

trans-unit.source: Accessible label announced before the value.

trans-unit.target: `AnnouncementBar` 的一則訊息。

trans-unit.source: Arc announcement bar: a slim banner for the top of a page. It rotates 2–4 short messages (the next one rises from below while the bar springs to the new height), pauses on hover, focus or a minimized window, and with `IsNavigationVisible` adds previous, next and a pause ring that fills over `Interval`. Messages can carry a call to action and a live countdown. Dismissing collapses the height so the page below eases up; with a `DismissalKey` the dismissal is remembered (`IMessageStorage`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 公告列：用於頁面頂部的細長橫幅。它輪播 2–4 則簡短訊息（下一則從下方升起，同時橫幅以彈簧變為新高度），滑鼠懸停、取得焦點或視窗最小化時暫停；設定 `IsNavigationVisible` 後會增加上一則、下一則按鈕，以及一個在 `Interval` 時間內逐漸填滿的暫停圓環。訊息可以帶有行動按鈕和即時倒數計時。關閉時高度收縮，使下方頁面平滑上移；若設定了 `DismissalKey`，關閉狀態會被記住（`IMessageStorage`）。

trans-unit.source: Find a meeting time that suits several people: a strip of days, the proposed times of the selected day with one mark per attendee (green when free, grey when busy), and a footer that sums up the choice with a button to book it. Choosing another day glides the day highlight there, slides the times in from that side and selects the first time that suits everyone; a time with busy attendees can still be booked, and the footer says who has to move a meeting. Booking turns the button into a quiet "Booked"; any new choice undoes it. The days, times and attendees are data you provide.

trans-unit.source: A team or set of contributors in a small space (Arc AvatarGroup): overlapping avatars with a 2px surface ring and a 1px border ring, later people stacked over earlier ones, and a "+N" chip for everyone past `MaxVisibleCount`. People who join or leave open or close their slot on the morph spring so the stack slides (P19); the overflow count rolls the way it moved (P14). Pointing at the stack (fine pointers only) loosens it from the center (P28) and lifts the person under the pointer with a crisp ring and their name while the neighbours ease aside (P27). Only the visible people get controls, so long member lists stay cheap. Items may be `AvatarGroupMember`, `Avatar` or plain names.
trans-unit.target: 少量空間內的團隊或一組貢獻者（Arc AvatarGroup）：頭像相互疊放，帶有 2px 的表面環和 1px 的邊框環，較晚加入的人疊在較早的人之上；超過 `MaxVisibleCount` 的人員以「+N」標籤表示。加入或離開的人員會以變形彈簧展開或收起其位置，使頭像堆疊平滑滑動（P19）；溢出數字的變化方向與其實際變化一致（P14）。指標懸停在堆疊上（僅限精確指標）時，頭像會從中心鬆散開（P28），指標下的人員會以清晰的環和姓名突出顯示，相鄰頭像同時讓開（P27）。只有可見的人員才會建立控制項，因此長成員清單依然輕量。項目可以是 `AvatarGroupMember`、`Avatar` 或純文字姓名。

trans-unit.source: A small pill for status, category or metadata (Arc Badge): a tone, an optional leading icon and a short label. It is a standalone inline label, not a count overlay. When a string or number label changes while the badge stays mounted, the new text rises out of a soft blur, the old one lifts away, and the pill width springs to fit (P2, P5); a new icon pops in from 0.6. Other content is shown as is. Reduced motion crossfades and the width jumps.
trans-unit.target: 用於狀態、分類或中繼資料的小型膠囊標籤（Arc Badge）：包含一種色調、可選的前置圖示和簡短文字。它是獨立的行內標籤，而不是數量角標。當字串或數字標籤在徽章保持掛載時發生變化，新文字從柔和模糊中升起，舊文字向上移出，膠囊寬度以彈簧適配（P2、P5）；新圖示從 0.6 倍大小彈出。其他內容按原樣顯示。減少動態效果模式下改為交叉淡入，寬度直接跳變。

trans-unit.source: Leading icon (for example an `ArcGlyph`); it takes the tone color and is hidden from assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 前置圖示（例如 `ArcGlyph`）；採用色調顏色，並對輔助技術隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Medium (26px, default) or Small (22px).

trans-unit.source: Shows the cell as a small pill colored by its value, such as a stage or a status. Map values to tones with `Tones` (or `ToneMap` in XAML); values without a mapping use `DefaultTone`.
trans-unit.target: 把儲存格顯示為依值著色的小膠囊，例如階段或狀態。用 `Tones`（XAML 中用 `ToneMap`）把值對應到色調；沒有對應的值使用 `DefaultTone`。

trans-unit.source: Arc's bar chart: one measure across a run of days, weeks or months, with an average reference line and a headline that reads the average at rest and the scrubbed bar while exploring. Bars grow in a left-to-right wave the first time the chart is seen; a new range zooms the slots around the latest bar while bars that keep their key morph, new ones grow beside them and leaving ones sink into the baseline. Motion is code-driven (`MotionValue` per bar) because bar heights, slots and the scale are coordinates inside the self-drawn plot, which ControlTheme transitions cannot reach.
trans-unit.target: Arc 長條圖：跨越一段天、週或月的單一指標，帶有平均值參考線；標題在靜止時顯示平均值，探索時顯示被掃過的長條。圖表首次出現時，長條按從左到右的波浪依序成長；切換範圍時，圖表圍繞最新的長條縮放各槽位，保留鍵值的長條會變形，新長條在其旁邊成長，被移除的長條則下沉至基線。動畫由程式碼驅動（每根長條一個 `MotionValue`），因為長條高度、槽位和刻度都是自繪繪圖區域中的座標，ControlTheme 的轉場無法觸及。

trans-unit.source: Headline label at rest, above the average.
trans-unit.target: 靜止時標題中平均值上方的標籤。

trans-unit.source: The range on show, such as "Sep 15–21, 2026". It rests under the headline.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的範圍，例如「Sep 15–21, 2026」。它位於標題下方。

trans-unit.source: Draws the average as a dashed reference line that springs to each new range.
trans-unit.target: 將平均值繪製為虛線參考線，並以彈簧過渡到每個新範圍。

trans-unit.source: Formats value-axis ticks. Defaults to the value format (Arc formats ticks like values).

trans-unit.source: A billing page in one view: the current plan with its status, price and next charge; the card on file and the billing email; and the invoice history with a download button per invoice. Every action raises a routed event for the host to handle (change or cancel the plan, update the card, edit the email, download an invoice). Older invoices beyond `VisibleInvoiceCount` fold behind "Show all invoices". Composed of `SettingsGroup`, `SettingsRow`, `Badge` and `Button`.

trans-unit.source: A modal sheet that rises from the bottom edge and rests at one or more heights (detents): trip details, share options, filters, map and media views where a peek is useful before the full view. One motion value drives the sheet: a drag follows the pointer 1:1, rubber-bands past the tallest detent, and on release projects 0.2s of its velocity to pick the nearest detent or close; a flick faster than 320px/s always moves at least one detent. The dim is a function of the sheet position. The grabber answers ArrowUp / ArrowDown / Home / End and toggles between the lowest and highest detent; reading keys on the sheet open it fully before scrolling; touch drags on the content move the sheet until it is fully open. Under reduced motion detents jump and the sheet fades. The sheet position is a `MotionValue`, not a ControlTheme transition: a drag writes it every move, a release hands the pointer velocity to the spring, and the scrim is computed from it each frame.
trans-unit.target: 從底部邊緣升起、停留在一個或多個高度（檔位）上的模態面板：適用於行程詳情、分享選項、篩選器、地圖和媒體檢視等需要先預覽、再檢視完整內容的情境。一個動作值驅動整個面板：拖曳時面板 1:1 跟隨指標，越過最高檔位時產生橡皮筋回彈；放開時，依 0.2s 內的速度投射位置，選擇最近的檔位或關閉；速度超過 320px/s 的快速輕掃至少會移動一個檔位。遮罩的暗度由面板位置決定。拖曳把手響應 ArrowUp / ArrowDown / Home / End，並在最低與最高檔位之間切換；面板上的閱讀鍵會先將其完全展開再捲動；在內容上進行觸控拖曳會移動面板，直到其完全展開。減少動態效果模式下，檔位直接跳轉，面板淡入淡出。面板位置是 `MotionValue`，而不是 ControlTheme 轉場：拖曳時每次移動都會寫入它，放開時將指標速度交給彈簧，遮罩則在每一影格由它計算。

trans-unit.source: Arc breadcrumb: where a page sits in a hierarchy, from the root to the current page. Crumbs are separated by chevrons; the last one is the current page (accent, medium weight, not a link) and every crumb reserves the width of its medium-weight label so becoming current never shifts the path. Crumbs present at first render stay still; crumbs added later slide in 8px from the path before them out of a subtle blur while their siblings make room on the smooth spring, and removed crumbs slide 4px back as they fade. Items are `BreadcrumbItem`s written inline or generated from `ItemsSource` (`ItemTemplate` renders the label). Choosing a crumb raises `ItemClick`, runs its `Command` and opens its `NavigateUri`. `MaxVisibleItems` (off by default, as in Arc) folds the middle of a long path into an overflow menu.
trans-unit.target: Arc 麵包屑：顯示頁面在層級中的位置，從根到目前頁面。各層級之間以箭頭分隔；最後一級為目前頁面（強調色、中等字重，不是連結）。每一級都會保留其中等字重標籤的寬度，因此成為目前頁面時路徑不會位移。首次渲染時已存在的層級保持靜止；之後新增的層級會從前一級的路徑位置滑入 8px，並在柔和模糊中出現，同層的其他項目則以平滑彈簧讓出空間；被移除的層級在淡出時滑回 4px。項目為內嵌寫入的 `BreadcrumbItem`，或由 `ItemsSource` 產生（`ItemTemplate` 渲染標籤）。選取某一級會引發 `ItemClick`，執行其 `Command` 並開啟其 `NavigateUri`。`MaxVisibleItems`（與 Arc 一樣預設關閉）會將較長路徑的中間部分摺疊進溢出選單。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a crumb or an overflow entry is chosen.
trans-unit.target: 選取某一級或溢出選單項目時引發。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.
trans-unit.target: 導覽地標的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: When greater than 1 and the path is longer, the root and the last `MaxVisibleItems − 1` crumbs stay visible and the rest collapse into an overflow menu. 0 (Arc default) never collapses.
trans-unit.target: 大於 1 且路徑較長時，保留根層級和最後 `MaxVisibleItems − 1` 個層級可見，其餘摺疊進溢出選單。0（Arc 預設）則從不摺疊。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the overflow button.

trans-unit.source: Arc's brush chart: a long, dense time series with an overview strip. Drag the window to pan, drag a handle to resize, drag across empty track to draw a new window, tap to recenter, double-click to reset. When the view is zoomed far out a seven-point average and its low-to-high band replace the raw line, crossfading by density. Events are marked on both charts and labelled where they fit. The value axis springs to the tallest point in view; the line draws in from the left the first time the chart is seen. Dragging is followed 1:1 by a local tracker (`ChartDragTracker`); presets, resets and bound `Range` changes glide the window on a smooth spring (`MotionValue`), because the window is a coordinate pair inside the self-drawn overview.
trans-unit.target: Arc 刷選圖表：帶有概覽條的長而密集的時間序列。拖曳視窗可平移，拖曳把手可調整大小，在空白軌道上拖曳可繪製新視窗，輕點可重新置中，雙擊可重設。視圖被縮放得很遠時，七點平均值及其低到高的帶狀區域會取代原始折線，並依資料密度交叉淡入。事件會同時標記在兩個圖表上，並在有空間時標註文字。數值軸以彈簧貼合視野中最高的點；折線在圖表首次出現時從左側繪製。拖曳由本地追蹤器（`ChartDragTracker`）1:1 跟隨；預設、重設以及繫結的 `Range` 變化會以平滑彈簧（`MotionValue`）滑動視窗，因為視窗是自繪概覽內的一對座標。

trans-unit.source: Events drawn as markers on both charts.
trans-unit.target: 在兩個圖表上以標記繪製的事件。

trans-unit.source: Arc button: a clear, responsive action with quiet secondary states. Presses scale on a snappy spring, label changes crossfade with a short blur while the width springs to fit, and `IsLoading` shows a spinner while keeping keyboard focus (clicks are swallowed instead of disabling the button).
trans-unit.target: Arc 按鈕：清晰、靈敏的操作，次要狀態安靜低調。按下時以輕快的彈簧縮放；文字變化時以短暫模糊交叉淡化，寬度以彈簧適配內容。`IsLoading` 顯示載入指示器，同時保留鍵盤焦點（點按會被忽略，而不是停用按鈕）。

trans-unit.source: Two to five related actions joined into one surface with hairline dividers (Arc button group): Share, Duplicate and Archive on a document, zoom controls, Reply / Reply all / Forward. One soft highlight glides between segments under the pointer or keyboard focus (the dividers beside it step aside), the pressed segment answers in place, and an optional chevron segment (`Menu`) opens rarer or destructive actions in a menu aligned to the group's edge. Segments are `ButtonGroupItem`s declared inline or generated from `ItemsSource` (plain data becomes the label). When a horizontal row does not fit, segments with an icon drop their label (it moves to the tooltip and the accessible name); if it still does not fit the row scrolls sideways without a scrollbar. Keyboard: every segment is a Tab stop; the arrow keys along the orientation (mirrored right to left), Home and End move between segments and wrap; Enter or Space activates. On the chevron, Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens the menu on the first row and Escape returns focus. A label that changes right after its segment was pressed (Share to Copied) is announced once.
trans-unit.target: 將兩到五個相關操作合併為一個帶細分隔線的整體（Arc 按鈕群組）：例如文件上的「分享」「複製」「封存」，縮放控制項，「回覆 / 全部回覆 / 轉寄」。指標或鍵盤焦點所在的區段下方有一個柔和高亮平滑滑動（旁邊的分隔線隨之讓開），被按下的區段原地作出回應；可選的下拉箭頭區段（`Menu`）會在與群組邊緣對齊的選單中開啟較少用或具破壞性的操作。區段可以是內嵌宣告的 `ButtonGroupItem`，也可以由 `ItemsSource` 產生（一般資料會成為標籤）。水平排列放不下時，帶圖示的區段會隱藏文字（文字移至提示與無障礙名稱）；若仍放不下，整列會橫向捲動且不顯示捲軸。鍵盤操作：每個區段都是 Tab 停駐點；沿排列方向的方向鍵（從右到左時鏡像）、Home 與 End 在區段間移動並循環；Enter 或空白鍵啟動。在下拉箭頭上，Enter、空白鍵或 ArrowDown 會在第一列開啟選單，Escape 將焦點移回。區段被按下後立即改變的標籤（如「分享」變為「已複製」）只播報一次。

trans-unit.target: 在區段自身的點按處理常式與命令執行之後引發。

trans-unit.source: A single-date month calendar. Months slide on one spring-driven strip (arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Today and a bound `DisplayMonth` all travel the same way), the title slides with them, and the selected disc glides between days while each number flips color as the disc passes it. Every month shows six weeks, so the height never changes. Full keyboard model: arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown (Shift = year), Enter/Space; disabled days are skipped in the direction of travel.
trans-unit.target: 單一日期的月曆。月份沿同一條彈簧驅動的帶狀區域滑動（箭頭、PageUp/PageDown、「今天」以及繫結的 `DisplayMonth` 都以相同方向移動），標題隨之滑動；選取的圓點在日期之間平滑移動，經過時數字的顏色隨之翻轉。每個月顯示六週，因此高度永不改變。完整的鍵盤操作：方向鍵、Home/End、PageUp/PageDown（按住 Shift 為整年）、Enter/空白鍵；被停用的日期會沿移動方向略過。

trans-unit.source: Culture for month and weekday names (null = current UI culture).
trans-unit.target: 月份與星期名稱所用的地區文化（null 表示目前 UI 文化）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the user picks a day (click, Enter / Space, or Today).
trans-unit.target: 使用者選取某一天時引發（點按、Enter / 空白鍵，或「今天」）。

trans-unit.source: Extra disabled days (weekends, booked dates...).
trans-unit.target: 額外停用的日期（週末、已被預訂的日期等）。

trans-unit.source: Any date in the displayed month (normalized to its first day). Defaults to the selection's month, else today's.
trans-unit.target: 顯示月份中的任意日期（會正規化為該月第一天）。預設為所選日期所在的月份，否則為今天所在的月份。

trans-unit.source: The first day of each week row (default Sunday).
trans-unit.target: 每一週列的第一天（預設為星期日）。

trans-unit.source: Latest selectable date; later days are disabled. Null means no upper limit.
trans-unit.target: 可選擇的最晚日期；之後的日期會被停用。null 表示沒有上限。

trans-unit.source: Earliest selectable date; earlier days are disabled. Null means no lower limit.
trans-unit.target: 可選擇的最早日期；之前的日期會被停用。null 表示沒有下限。

trans-unit.source: Label of the next-month button (default "Next month").
trans-unit.target: 下個月按鈕的標籤（預設為「下個月」）。

trans-unit.source: Label of the previous-month button (default "Previous month").
trans-unit.target: 上個月按鈕的標籤（預設為「上個月」）。

trans-unit.source: The selected date, or null when nothing is selected. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 選取的日期；未選取時為 null。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Adds a Today button that slides back to the current month and selects today when it is available.
trans-unit.target: 新增一個「今天」按鈕：點按後平滑回到目前月份，並在可用時選取今天。

trans-unit.source: Text of the Today button (default "Today").
trans-unit.target: 今天按鈕的文字（預設為「今天」）。

trans-unit.source: A considerate cancellation flow in one card: it asks why, offers an alternative that fits the reason, shows what ends and when, and asks the person to hold a button to confirm; the last step thanks them or lets them reactivate. A step bar on top shows where they are. Steps slide in the direction of travel while the card's height follows on a spring; each step's controls are built once and reused. Enter runs the step's main action, Alt+Left goes back, and focus moves to the new step's title after every change.
trans-unit.target: 單一卡片內的體貼取消流程：先詢問原因，提供符合該原因的挽留方案，說明哪些內容何時終止，並要求使用者按住按鈕確認；最後一步會向使用者致謝，或允許其重新啟用。頂部的步驟列顯示目前位置。步驟會沿移動方向滑入，卡片高度則以彈簧動態效果跟隨變化；每個步驟的控制項只建立一次並重複使用。按下 Enter 執行該步驟的主要動作，Alt+Left 返回上一步，每次變更後焦點都會移至新步驟的標題。

trans-unit.source: The last day of paid access after canceling (usually the renewal date); null when access ends at once.
trans-unit.target: 取消後可繼續使用付費權限的最後一天（通常為續訂日期）；為 null 時表示立即結束存取。

trans-unit.source: Card (default) draws the flow's own frame; Plain drops it for a flow inside a dialog or another card.
trans-unit.target: Card（預設）會繪製流程自身的框線；Plain 則移除框線，適用於對話方塊或其他卡片內的流程。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the hold to cancel completes (the flow moves to Canceled), with the reason and the feedback.
trans-unit.target: 按住取消操作完成時引發（流程轉為 Canceled），附帶原因與回饋。

trans-unit.source: The offer for reasons without one of their own; null skips the offer step for them.
trans-unit.target: 供沒有專屬方案的原因使用的挽留方案；為 null 時，這些原因將跳過挽留方案步驟。

trans-unit.source: What the person wrote in the optional feedback field (two-way); null when empty.
trans-unit.target: 使用者在選填回饋欄位中填寫的內容（雙向繫結）；為空時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised by "Keep my plan" and by "Done" after an accepted offer: the person is staying, so close the flow.
trans-unit.target: 由「保留我的方案」以及接受挽留方案後的「完成」引發：使用者選擇留下，因此應關閉流程。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text and date culture; replace the whole object to localize the flow.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字與日期地區設定；取代整個物件即可在地化此流程。

trans-unit.source: What ends with the plan, listed on the confirmation step (for example "Shared projects become read-only").
trans-unit.target: 隨方案一併終止的內容，列在確認步驟中（例如「共用專案變為唯讀」）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person accepts the offer (the flow moves to Retained), with the reason and the offer.
trans-unit.target: 使用者接受挽留方案時引發（流程轉為 Retained），附帶原因與該方案。

trans-unit.source: The plan's name as people know it, such as "Studio"; used in the titles and sentences.
trans-unit.target: 方案的名稱，即使用者熟知的稱呼，例如「Studio」；用於標題與句子中。

trans-unit.source: Raised by "Reactivate plan" on the canceled step. Unless a handler marks it handled, the flow then calls `Reset`.
trans-unit.target: 在已取消步驟中按下「重新啟用方案」時引發。除非處理常式將其標示為已處理，否則流程隨後會呼叫 `Reset`。

trans-unit.source: The reasons to choose from, written inline or bound. Empty (the default) uses the five reasons in `DefaultReasons`.
trans-unit.target: 可供選擇的原因，可直接寫入或繫結。為空（預設值）時使用 `DefaultReasons` 中的五個原因。

trans-unit.source: The chosen reason (two-way); Continue is disabled while it is null.
trans-unit.target: 所選原因（雙向繫結）；為 null 時「繼續」按鈕不可用。

trans-unit.source: The step on screen: Reason, Offer, Confirm, Canceled or Retained. Changes through the flow's buttons, `GoBack` and `Reset`.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的步驟：Reason、Offer、Confirm、Canceled 或 Retained。透過流程中的按鈕、`GoBack` 與 `Reset` 變更。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the step changes, with the old and the new step.
trans-unit.target: 步驟變更後引發，附帶舊步驟與新步驟。

trans-unit.source: A memory the assistant has just noted: `Note` (such as "Noted: you run builds with the dotnet CLI") shows in the captured pill until the person files it, after which the pill shows "Saved to" the group.
trans-unit.target: 助手剛記下的一則記憶：`Note`（例如「已記下：你用 dotnet CLI 執行建置」）會在已記下的膠囊中顯示，直到使用者將其歸檔；歸檔後，膠囊會顯示「已儲存到」加上群組名稱。

trans-unit.source: The memory to file; it is added to `Memories` when the pill is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 要歸檔的記憶；按下膠囊時會將其新增到 `Memories`。

trans-unit.source: The short sentence the pill shows, such as "Noted: you run builds with the dotnet CLI".
trans-unit.target: 膠囊顯示的簡短句子，例如「已記下：你用 dotnet CLI 執行建置」。

trans-unit.source: Arc card: a contained group of related content and actions for browsable grid items (projects, listings, posts), with optional media, an owner byline and a status line that updates in place. A pointed-at card lifts 2px on a snappy spring while its border and shadow deepen and the media drifts to 1.04 (mouse only). Set `Details` and the title becomes a button and the whole card a trigger: the card grows into a larger quick look without leaving the page (P8): its surface, media, title, description, byline and action fly into a `DialogSurface` on the overlay layer on one critically damped spring (0.3s; 0.26s back) while the corners morph, the details rise in after 120ms and the page dims behind a 7px backdrop blur. Escape, the scrim or the close button send it back into the card and return focus to the title. Reduced motion fades the quick look instead.
trans-unit.target: Arc 卡片：用於可瀏覽的網格項目（專案、刊登、貼文）的一組相關內容與操作，可選包含媒體、擁有者署名以及會原地更新的狀態列。指標停在卡片上時，卡片以輕快的彈簧上浮 2px，邊框與陰影加深，媒體緩慢放大至 1.04（僅限滑鼠）。設定 `Details` 後，標題變為按鈕，整張卡片變為觸發器：卡片會擴展為較大的快速預覽而不離開頁面（P8）：其表面、媒體、標題、描述、署名與操作會以臨界阻尼彈簧（0.3 秒；收回為 0.26 秒）飛入覆蓋層上的 `DialogSurface`，同時圓角變形，細節在 120 毫秒後浮現，頁面則在 7px 的背景模糊下變暗。按 Escape、點按遮罩或關閉按鈕可使其收回卡片，並將焦點返回標題。減少動態效果時，快速預覽改為淡入淡出。

trans-unit.source: Trailing footer control (a button); stays separately focusable and clickable over the card.
trans-unit.target: 底部尾隨的控制項（按鈕）；在卡片上仍可單獨取得焦點並點按。

trans-unit.source: Small leading footer visual, such as the owner's `Avatar` (shown in a 32px circle).
trans-unit.target: 底部前導的小型視覺元素，例如擁有者的 `Avatar`（顯示在 32px 的圓形中）。

trans-unit.source: Backdrop blur behind the quick look in px (the theme sets Arc's 7; off under ReduceTransparency).
trans-unit.target: 快速預覽背後的背景模糊程度，單位為 px（主題設定為 Arc 的 7；在 ReduceTransparency 下關閉）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the quick look's close button.
trans-unit.target: 快速預覽關閉按鈕的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Supporting line under the title (at most 34 characters per line).
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的輔助文字（每行最多 34 個字元）。

trans-unit.source: Quick look content. When set, the whole card opens and grows into a larger view.
trans-unit.target: 快速預覽的內容。設定後，整張卡片會開啟並擴展為較大的檢視。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the quick look opens or closes (the close motion may still be playing).
trans-unit.target: 快速預覽開啟或關閉時引發（關閉動態效果可能仍在播放）。

trans-unit.source: Quick look open state (Arc open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange). Two-way; ignored without `Details`.
trans-unit.target: 快速預覽的開啟狀態（Arc 中的 open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange）。雙向繫結；沒有 `Details` 時忽略。

trans-unit.source: Image or visual at the top; it drifts in slightly while the card is pointed at.
trans-unit.target: 頂部的圖片或視覺元素；指標停在卡片上時會輕微放大。

trans-unit.source: Who the card belongs to, such as the owner's name.
trans-unit.target: 卡片所屬的對象，例如擁有者的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Scrim behind the quick look (the theme sets Arc's oklch(10% 0 0 / 0.46)).
trans-unit.target: 快速預覽背後的遮罩（主題設定為 Arc 的 oklch(10% 0 0 / 0.46)）。

trans-unit.source: A short status under the meta ("Updated 2 hours ago"); new words rise in and are announced politely.
trans-unit.target: 位於 meta 下方的簡短狀態（「2 小時前更新」）；新文字會上浮出現，並以禮貌方式播報。

trans-unit.source: Heading (required). Becomes the quick look trigger when `Details` is set.
trans-unit.target: 標題（必填）。設定 `Details` 後，標題會成為快速預覽的觸發器。

trans-unit.source: A deck of cards reviewed one at a time (Arc card stack): drag or flick the top card left or right, or use the buttons and arrow keys. Use it for quick, one-by-one triage where each item deserves a moment of attention: shortlisting destinations, candidates or design options. The top card tilts with the drag and shows a stamp; a flick or a long enough drag throws it out with the release velocity, the cards behind rise into place, Undo flies the last card back from where it left, and Start over deals the deck back. Only the top four cards (and cards still in flight) are realized, however long the stack. Keyboard on the focused stage: ← / → decide, Backspace or Ctrl / Cmd + Z undo. Decisions, undo and reset are announced politely. Items come from `Items` / `ItemsSource` with `ItemTemplate`; changing the items starts the stack over.
trans-unit.target: 一疊逐張審閱的卡片（Arc 卡片堆疊）：拖曳或輕掃頂部卡片向左或向右，也可使用按鈕與方向鍵。適用於需要逐一細看的快速篩選，例如候選目的地、候選人或設計方案的初選。頂部卡片會隨拖曳傾斜並顯示印章；輕掃或足夠長的拖曳會以放開時的速度將其甩出，後面的卡片上升就位；「復原」會將上一張卡片從離開的位置飛回；「重新開始」會把整疊卡片重新發牌。無論堆疊多深，只會實例化頂部四張卡片（以及仍在飛行中的卡片）。焦點位於舞台上時的鍵盤操作：← / → 作出決定，Backspace 或 Ctrl / Cmd + Z 復原。決定、復原與重設均以禮貌方式播報。項目來自 `Items` / `ItemsSource`，並配合 `ItemTemplate`；變更項目會使卡片堆重新開始。

trans-unit.source: True when there is a decision to undo.
trans-unit.target: 存在可復原的決定時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Index of the top card (equals the item count once every card is decided).
trans-unit.target: 頂部卡片的索引（所有卡片都已決定後等於項目總數）。

trans-unit.source: A card was decided (by drag, key, button or `Decide`).
trans-unit.target: 某張卡片已被決定（透過拖曳、按鍵、按鈕或 `Decide`）。

trans-unit.source: The last decision was undone; the card is back on top.
trans-unit.target: 上一個決定已被復原；該卡片回到頂部。

trans-unit.source: Shown once every card has been decided, instead of "All cards reviewed" and Start over.
trans-unit.target: 所有卡片都已決定後顯示，取代「所有卡片已審閱」與「重新開始」。

trans-unit.source: Data template that builds the empty-state content; used when `EmptyContent` is not set.
trans-unit.target: 用於建立空白狀態內容的資料範本；未設定 `EmptyContent` 時使用。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the stack (default "Cards").
trans-unit.target: 卡片堆的無障礙名稱（預設為「Cards」）。

trans-unit.source: A short name for a card, used in its accessible label and in announcements ("Lisbon"). Defaults to the item's text (a string, a control's automation name, or `ToString()`).
trans-unit.target: 卡片的簡短名稱，用於其無障礙標籤與播報（例如「Lisbon」）。預設為項目的文字（字串、控制項的自動化名稱或 `ToString()`）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the left action, on its button and on the stamp while dragging left (default "Pass").
trans-unit.target: 左側操作的名稱，顯示在其按鈕上，以及拖向左側時的印章上（預設為「Pass」）。

trans-unit.source: Past tense of the left action for announcements, such as "skipped". Without it: "Lisbon: Pass."
trans-unit.target: 用於播報的左側操作過去式，例如「skipped」。未設定時為：「Lisbon: Pass.」

trans-unit.source: Brings every card back (for custom empty content: `Command="{Binding $parent[arc:CardStack].ResetCommand}"`).
trans-unit.target: 將所有卡片全部復原（用於自訂空內容：`Command="{Binding $parent[arc:CardStack].ResetCommand}"`）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the right action (default "Keep").
trans-unit.target: 右側操作的名稱（預設為「Keep」）。

trans-unit.source: Past tense of the right action for announcements, such as "shortlisted".
trans-unit.target: 用於播報的右側操作過去式，例如「shortlisted」。

trans-unit.source: All cards were brought back.
trans-unit.target: 所有卡片已全部復原。

trans-unit.source: A row of slides people browse by dragging, flicking, a trackpad swipe, the arrow keys, or the controls below it (Arc carousel). Use it for a short, ordered set of peers such as products or case studies, where the neighbours stay in view as a hint that there is more. The active slide sits in the center, its neighbours shrink and dim with distance, and the page indicator stretches into a pill that travels with the slides frame by frame. Slides come from `Items` / `ItemsSource` (with `ItemTemplate`); `SelectedIndex` is the active slide (two-way). Set `Interval` to add a play control that rotates through the slides; rotation pauses on hover, keyboard focus, drag, while the carousel is scrolled out of view or the window is minimized, and is unavailable with reduced motion. Only the slides near the current position are realized.
trans-unit.target: 一排投影片，使用者可透過拖曳、輕掃、觸控板滑動、方向鍵或其下方的控制項進行瀏覽（Arc 輪播）。適用於一組簡短、有序的同類內容，例如產品或案例研究，相鄰項目保持可見，以提示還有更多內容。目前投影片位於中央，相鄰投影片會隨距離縮小並變暗，頁面指示器會拉伸成一個膠囊，並隨投影片逐格移動。投影片來自 `Items` / `ItemsSource`（配合 `ItemTemplate`）；`SelectedIndex` 為目前投影片（雙向繫結）。設定 `Interval` 可新增一個播放控制項，使投影片循環輪播；指標停留、鍵盤焦點、拖曳、輪播捲出可視範圍或視窗最小化時輪播會暫停，減少動態效果時則不可用。只有目前位置附近的投影片會被實例化。

trans-unit.source: True when rotation is available (an interval, two or more slides, full motion).
trans-unit.target: 可以輪播時為 true（需要有間隔時間、兩張或更多投影片，且為完整動態效果）。

trans-unit.source: Time per slide. A positive value adds a play control that rotates through the slides.
trans-unit.target: 每張投影片的停留時間。正值會新增一個播放控制項，使投影片循環輪播。

trans-unit.source: Whether the slides rotate (two-way; the play control toggles it). Off by default, so motion begins with the viewer; set it to start rotating on load.
trans-unit.target: 投影片是否輪播（雙向繫結；播放控制項會切換此值）。預設關閉，使動態效果由使用者開始；若希望載入後即開始輪播，請將其設為 true。

trans-unit.source: True while the rotation timer is actually running (playing and not paused).
trans-unit.target: 輪播計時器確實在執行（正在播放且未暫停）時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Names the carousel for assistive technology, for example "From the Harbour suites".
trans-unit.target: 為輔助技術命名此輪播，例如「From the Harbour suites」。

trans-unit.source: Largest slide width in px (340).
trans-unit.target: 投影片的最大寬度，單位為 px（340）。

trans-unit.source: Gap between slides in px (16).
trans-unit.target: 投影片之間的間距，單位為 px（16）。

trans-unit.source: Names each slide and its indicator; defaults to "2 of 5".
trans-unit.target: 為每張投影片及其指示器命名；預設為「2 of 5」。

trans-unit.source: Share of the carousel width one slide takes (Arc default `min(80cqw, 340px)`: 0.8).
trans-unit.target: 單張投影片佔輪播寬度的比例（Arc 預設 `min(80cqw, 340px)`：0.8）。

trans-unit.source: The point being read (crosshair, scrubbed bar, hovered segment), or null at rest. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 正在讀取的資料點（十字準線、被拖曳的柱子、懸停的區段），靜止時為 null。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Raised as the readout moves between points, and with a null index when it is released.
trans-unit.target: 讀數在各資料點之間移動時引發；釋放時以 null 索引引發。

trans-unit.source: The latest polite announcement (what Arc's live region reads), such as "Loading".
trans-unit.target: 最新的禮貌播報內容（即 Arc 即時區域所朗讀的文字），例如「Loading」。

trans-unit.source: Name of the category column in the data table and the explore label, such as "Date".
trans-unit.target: 資料表中類別欄的名稱以及探索標籤，例如「Date」。

trans-unit.source: Smooth monotone curves that never swing past the data, or straight segments.
trans-unit.target: 平滑的單調曲線（永不超出資料範圍），或直線段。

trans-unit.source: The accessible data table as text: a header line, then one line per row (tab separated).
trans-unit.target: 以文字形式呈現的無障礙資料表：一行表頭，然後每列資料一行（以定位字元分隔）。

trans-unit.source: Shown when there is nothing to draw.
trans-unit.target: 沒有可繪製內容時顯示。

trans-unit.source: Keys of hidden series. Two-way; the legend toggles it.
trans-unit.target: 已隱藏系列的鍵。雙向繫結；圖例會切換此值。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the legend shows or hides a series.
trans-unit.target: 圖例顯示或隱藏某個系列時引發。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the current shapes on screen, dimmed and breathing, while the next range loads.
trans-unit.target: 在載入下一個範圍期間，保持目前圖形在螢幕上，並以變暗與呼吸式的動態效果呈現。

trans-unit.source: The data items. Values are read with `YSelector`/`YBinding` (or per series), categories with `XSelector`/`XBinding`.
trans-unit.target: 資料項目。數值透過 `YSelector`/`YBinding`（或依系列）讀取，類別透過 `XSelector`/`XBinding` 讀取。

trans-unit.source: What is measured, such as "Signups". Names the chart, its summary and its data table.
trans-unit.target: 所量測的內容，例如「Signups」。用於命名圖表、其摘要與資料表。

trans-unit.source: Plot height in pixels; the width follows the container.
trans-unit.target: 繪圖區的高度，單位為像素；寬度隨容器變化。

trans-unit.source: Horizontal gridlines at the value ticks.
trans-unit.target: 在數值刻度處顯示水平網格線。

trans-unit.source: Series toggles. Null shows the legend when there is more than one series.
trans-unit.target: 系列切換開關。為 null 時，若有多個系列則顯示圖例。

trans-unit.source: The category (time) axis labels under the plot.
trans-unit.target: 繪圖區下方的類別（時間）軸標籤。

trans-unit.source: The value axis labels in the right-hand gutter.
trans-unit.target: 右側邊界中的數值軸標籤。

trans-unit.source: A one-paragraph description for assistive technology, such as "Signups, Sep 1 to Sep 30. ...".
trans-unit.target: 供輔助技術使用的一段式描述，例如「Signups, Sep 1 to Sep 30. ...」。

trans-unit.source: Formats value-axis ticks. Defaults to a compact number, such as 1.2K.
trans-unit.target: 格式化數值軸的刻度。預設為精簡數字，例如 1.2K。

trans-unit.source: Unit after each value in readouts, such as "ms".
trans-unit.target: 讀數中每個數值後的單位，例如「ms」。

trans-unit.source: .NET format string for values (en-US), such as "N0", "C0" or "0.0'%'". Null uses the chart's default.
trans-unit.target: 數值的 .NET 格式字串（en-US），例如 “N0”、“C0” 或 “0.0'%'”。為 null 時使用圖表的預設格式。

trans-unit.source: Formats values with context (series, index); wins over `ValueFormat`.
trans-unit.target: 結合上下文（系列、索引）格式化數值；優先於 `ValueFormat`。

trans-unit.source: Short axis label of a category; return null to keep the axis quiet there. Dates default to "Sep 15".
trans-unit.target: 類別的簡短軸標籤；傳回 null 可使該處的軸保持安靜。日期預設為「Sep 15」。

trans-unit.source: Reads each item's category or date: the AOT-safe path form, such as `XBinding="{CompiledBinding Date, DataType=local:Day}"` (a reflection `{Binding Date}` also works).
trans-unit.target: 讀取每個項目的類別或日期：AOT 安全的路徑形式，例如 `XBinding="{CompiledBinding Date, DataType=local:Day}"`（反射形式的 `{Binding Date}` 同樣可用）。

trans-unit.source: Full label of a category (tooltip, headline, screen readers). Dates default to "Tue, Sep 15".
trans-unit.target: 類別的完整標籤（提示、標題、螢幕閱讀器）。日期預設為「Tue, Sep 15」。

trans-unit.source: Reads each item's category or date (a string, DateTime, DateTimeOffset or DateOnly).
trans-unit.target: 讀取每個項目的類別或日期（字串、DateTime、DateTimeOffset 或 DateOnly）。

trans-unit.source: Reads each item's value for a single-series chart (`YBinding="{CompiledBinding Visits, DataType=local:Day}"`).
trans-unit.target: 為單一系列圖表讀取每個項目的數值（`YBinding="{CompiledBinding Visits, DataType=local:Day}"`）。

trans-unit.source: Fixes the top of the value axis (default: the next nice tick above the data).
trans-unit.target: 固定數值軸的頂部（預設為資料之上的下一個整齊刻度）。

trans-unit.source: Fixes the bottom of the value axis (default: zero, or the data minimum when it dips below).
trans-unit.target: 固定數值軸的底部（預設為零；若資料低於零，則為資料的最小值）。

trans-unit.source: Reads each item's value for a single-series chart.
trans-unit.target: 為單一系列圖表讀取每個項目的數值。

trans-unit.source: A message (Arc `ChatMessage`). Update `Text`, `Status`, `Reactions` or `Attachments` in place and the thread follows (the message raises `PropertyChanged`).
trans-unit.target: 一則訊息（Arc `ChatMessage`）。原地更新 `Text`、`Status`、`Reactions` 或 `Attachments`，對話串隨之更新（訊息會引發 `PropertyChanged`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a property changes.
trans-unit.target: 屬性變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: A chat or support thread (Arc `ChatThread`): messages grouped by person and time with day separators, reactions, read receipts that glide to the latest read message, a typing indicator and a composer with attachments. The list stays pinned to the newest message and offers a pill when new messages land out of view.
trans-unit.target: 聊天或支援對話串（Arc `ChatThread`）：訊息依人員與時間分組，並帶有日期分隔、表情回應、已讀回執（平滑移動到最新的已讀訊息）、輸入中提示，以及帶附件的編輯區。清單始終固定在最新訊息處；當有新訊息落在可視範圍之外時，會顯示一個提示膠囊。

trans-unit.source: File types the attach button offers (Arc `accept`); null offers everything.
trans-unit.target: 附件按鈕提供的檔案類型（Arc `accept`）；為 null 時提供所有類型。

trans-unit.source: A picture or file was clicked; mark it handled to stop the thread from opening it.
trans-unit.target: 圖片或檔案被點按時引發；將其標記為已處理可阻止對話串開啟它。

trans-unit.source: Formatting culture of times and day separators (Arc `locale`); null uses en-US.
trans-unit.target: 時間與日期分隔所用的格式化地區文化（Arc `locale`）；為 null 時使用 en-US。

trans-unit.source: The current user (Arc `currentUserId`): their messages sit on the right in the accent color.
trans-unit.target: 目前使用者（Arc `currentUserId`）：其訊息以強調色顯示在右側。

trans-unit.source: Messages from one person closer together than this share a group (Arc `groupWindow`, 5 minutes).
trans-unit.target: 同一人員在此時間間隔內發送的訊息歸為一組（Arc `groupWindow`，5 分鐘）。

trans-unit.source: Lets the composer take files by button, paste or drop (Arc `allowAttachments`, default true).
trans-unit.target: 允許編輯區透過按鈕、貼上或拖放接收檔案（Arc `allowAttachments`，預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the composer (Arc `composer`, default true).
trans-unit.target: 顯示編輯區（Arc `composer`，預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the list follows the newest message (the reader is within 48px of the end).
trans-unit.target: 列表是否跟隨最新訊息（閱讀者距離末尾在 48px 以內）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the message log (Arc `label`, "Conversation").
trans-unit.target: 訊息紀錄的無障礙名稱（Arc `label`，“Conversation”）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the thread shows or announces (Arc `labels`).
trans-unit.target: 對話串中顯示或播報的所有文字（Arc `labels`）。

trans-unit.source: StreamMark services for Markdown bodies; null uses `DefaultMarkdownServices`.
trans-unit.target: 用於 Markdown 內文的 StreamMark 服務；為 null 時使用 `DefaultMarkdownServices`。

trans-unit.source: How message text renders unless a message sets `Format` (default Markdown).
trans-unit.target: 除非訊息設定了 `Format`，否則訊息文字的渲染方式（預設為 Markdown）。

trans-unit.source: The people in the conversation (Arc `participants`).
trans-unit.target: 對話中的參與者（Arc `participants`）。

trans-unit.source: The composer's placeholder and accessible name ("Message").
trans-unit.target: 輸入框的預留位置文字，也是其無障礙名稱（“Message”）。

trans-unit.source: A reaction was picked or a chip clicked (Arc `onReact`). Without an ItemsSource the thread also toggles it.
trans-unit.target: 選取了一個表情回應或按一下了一個回應標籤（Arc `onReact`）。沒有設定 ItemsSource 時，對話串也會切換該回應。

trans-unit.source: Emoji offered by the reaction picker (Arc default 👍 ❤️ 😂 🎉 👀 🙏).
trans-unit.target: 表情回應選擇器提供的表情（Arc 預設 👍 ❤️ 😂 🎉 👀 🙏）。

trans-unit.source: The last message each participant has read, by participant id (Arc `readBy`). Their portrait sits under that message and glides when it moves. Assign a new dictionary to update.
trans-unit.target: 每位參與者已讀的最後一則訊息，以參與者 id 為鍵（Arc `readBy`）。其頭像位於該訊息下方，移動時會平滑滑動。指定新的字典即可更新。

trans-unit.source: Invoked with the failed `ChatMessage` when Retry is clicked; Retry shows when this or a handler is set.
trans-unit.target: 按一下重試時以失敗的 `ChatMessage` 作為參數呼叫；設定此項或處理常式後顯示重試按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Retry was clicked on your last, failed message (Arc `onRetry`).
trans-unit.target: 按一下了你最後一則失敗訊息的重試（Arc `onRetry`）。

trans-unit.source: Your message from the composer (Arc `onSend`). Without an ItemsSource the thread also appends it.
trans-unit.target: 來自輸入框的你的訊息（Arc `onSend`）。沒有設定 ItemsSource 時，對話串也會將其附加進去。

trans-unit.source: Time zone of times and day separators; null uses the local zone (as Arc's browser does).
trans-unit.target: 時間與日期分隔符所用的時區；為 null 時使用本機時區（與 Arc 瀏覽器一致）。

trans-unit.source: Participant ids currently typing (Arc `typing`); an observable collection is followed live.
trans-unit.target: 目前正在輸入的參與者 id（Arc `typing`）；若為可觀察集合則會即時追蹤。

trans-unit.source: Messages from other people that arrived while the reader was scrolled up.
trans-unit.target: 閱讀者向上捲動時，其他人傳來的訊息數量。

trans-unit.source: Arc checkbox: a binary choice with a precise, legible state. The fill grows in on a snappy spring, the check draws itself, and the indeterminate state morphs the same three-point path into a dash and back. Only the 18px square answers a press (it dips to 0.95); the 44px hit area and the label never move. Clicking an indeterminate box checks it (Radix behavior). `IsChecked` is the tri-state value (null = indeterminate); `CheckedState` is the same value as an enum.
trans-unit.target: Arc 核取方塊：二元選擇，狀態精確清晰。勾選框以輕快的彈簧效果填滿，勾號自行繪出，半選狀態會將同一條三點路徑變形為短橫線，再變回來。只有 18px 方塊回應按壓（會下沉至 0.95）；44px 點擊區域與標籤都不會移動。按一下半選方塊會將其勾選（Radix 行為）。`IsChecked` 為三態值（null 表示半選）；`CheckedState` 是同一個值的列舉形式。

trans-unit.source: The tri-state value as an enum; kept in sync with `IsChecked`.
trans-unit.target: 以列舉表示的三態值；與 `IsChecked` 保持同步。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the state changes, with the old and new `CheckboxState`.
trans-unit.target: 狀態變更時觸發，附帶舊的與新的 `CheckboxState`。

trans-unit.source: Secondary text under the label; also the help text read by assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 標籤下方的次要文字，同時也是輔助技術朗讀的說明文字。

trans-unit.source: Marks the choice as invalid (the square takes the danger border).
trans-unit.target: 將該選項標記為無效（方塊採用危險色邊框）。

trans-unit.source: The field must be checked before a form is submitted (reported to assistive technology).
trans-unit.target: 表單提交前必須勾選此欄位（會告知輔助技術）。

trans-unit.source: Draws a yes or no value as a checkbox in the middle of the cell; a click on it flips the value (one undo step, and `CellEditEnding` can refuse it). Boolean columns use it without setting `Renderer`; set it on a column of another type to show a 0 or 1 that way. Values that are not a `Boolean` draw as text.
trans-unit.target: 在儲存格中間把是或否的值畫成核取方塊；點擊它會翻轉值（是一步復原，`CellEditEnding` 可以拒絕）。Boolean 欄無需設定 `Renderer` 就會使用它；設定在其他類型的欄上，可以用這種方式顯示 0 或 1。不是 `Boolean` 的值會畫成文字。

trans-unit.source: Arc chip group: toggle chips for facets people switch often (topics, statuses, tags). Picking a chip morphs it: a check grows in, the label slides over and the chip's edge follows on a spring while the neighbours glide to their new places, even across lines. Long sets fold behind a "+N more" chip (selected chips always stay in view); expanding staggers the revealed chips in and the group height springs. With `IsMultiple` false it is a single choice that can still be cleared. Keyboard: one tab stop; arrows move between chips and wrap, Home / End jump to the ends; Enter or Space toggles the focused chip or expands the folded ones.
trans-unit.target: Arc 標籤群組：用於人們經常切換的篩選項（主題、狀態、標籤）的可切換標籤。選取標籤時會變形：勾號生長出來，文字滑動，標籤邊緣以彈簧跟隨，相鄰標籤滑動到新位置，即使跨行也是如此。項目較多時，會摺疊到一個 "+N more" 標籤之後（已選取的標籤始終可見）；展開時，被顯示的標籤依序淡入，群組的高度以彈簧變化。`IsMultiple` 為 false 時為單選，但仍可清除選取。鍵盤操作：只有一個 Tab 停留點；方向鍵在標籤之間移動並循環，Home / End 跳到兩端；Enter 或空白鍵切換焦點標籤，或展開摺疊的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsExpanded` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IsExpanded` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsMultiple` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IsMultiple` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the group, such as "Topics".
trans-unit.target: 群組的無障礙名稱，例如“Topics”。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `MaxVisibleItems` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `MaxVisibleItems` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `SelectedItems` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `SelectedItems` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Values of the selected options, in option order (Arc keeps `value` in option order).
trans-unit.target: 已選選項的值，依選項順序排列（Arc 依選項順序保留 `value`）。

trans-unit.source: Label of a data item (AOT-safe alternative to `DisplayMemberBinding`).
trans-unit.target: 資料項目的標籤（AOT 安全的 `DisplayMemberBinding` 替代方案）。

trans-unit.source: Value of a data item (AOT-safe alternative to `SelectedValueBinding`).
trans-unit.target: 資料項目的值（AOT 安全的 `SelectedValueBinding` 替代方案）。

trans-unit.source: A source viewer with a file-name header, syntax highlighting (TextMate grammars painted in Arc's role palette), a copy action and optional collapsing. Long sources collapse to `MaxLines` lines with a toggle that expands the rest in place on a smooth height spring; new code fades in with a short rise. Long lines scroll horizontally inside the block.
trans-unit.target: 原始碼檢視器，帶檔名標題列、語法醒目提示（使用 TextMate 語法，以 Arc 角色調色盤上色）、複製動作，以及可選的摺疊功能。較長的原始碼會摺疊到 `MaxLines` 行，按一下切換按鈕可在原地以平滑的高度彈簧展開其餘部分；新程式碼以短暫的上升動畫淡入。過長的行會在區塊內水平捲動。

trans-unit.source: Source shown in the block and copied by the action.
trans-unit.target: 在程式碼區塊中顯示並由複製動作複製的原始碼。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the copy action put the code on the clipboard.
trans-unit.target: 複製動作將程式碼放入剪貼簿後觸發。

trans-unit.source: Label of the copy button in the header (default "Copy code").
trans-unit.target: 標題列中複製按鈕的標籤（預設為「複製程式碼」）。

trans-unit.source: File name in the header; `SourceCodeLabel` when null.
trans-unit.target: 標題列中的檔名；為 null 時使用 `SourceCodeLabel`。

trans-unit.source: Collapses sources longer than `MaxLines` lines behind a "Show all" toggle (Arc `maxLines`).
trans-unit.target: 超過 `MaxLines` 行的原始碼會摺疊，並顯示“Show all”切換按鈕（Arc `maxLines`）。

trans-unit.source: Whether a collapsible source shows all of its lines.
trans-unit.target: 可摺疊的原始碼是否顯示全部行。

trans-unit.source: Header label and highlighting language (Arc default "tsx"): a fence-style name or alias such as `cs`, `ts`, `json`, `xml`/`axaml`, `py`, `sh`. Languages without a TextMate grammar show plain text.
trans-unit.target: 標題標籤與語法醒目提示所用的語言（Arc 預設 “tsx”）：圍欄式的名稱或別名，如 `cs`、`ts`、`json`、`xml`/`axaml`、`py`、`sh`。沒有 TextMate 語法的語言將顯示為純文字。

trans-unit.source: Number of lines in `Code`.
trans-unit.target: `Code` 中的行數。

trans-unit.source: Lines visible while collapsed.
trans-unit.target: 摺疊狀態下可見的行數。

trans-unit.source: Collapsed toggle label; `{0}` is the line count.
trans-unit.target: 摺疊時切換按鈕的文字；`{0}` 為行數。

trans-unit.source: Label of the toggle while a collapsed source is expanded (default "Show fewer lines").
trans-unit.target: 展開摺疊的原始碼時，切換按鈕的標籤（預設為「顯示較少行」）。

trans-unit.source: Shows a line-number gutter (an extension; Arc has none).
trans-unit.target: 顯示行號欄（此為擴充功能，Arc 本身沒有）。

trans-unit.source: Header text shown when `FileName` is empty (default "Source code").
trans-unit.target: `FileName` 為空時顯示的標題文字（預設為「原始碼」）。

trans-unit.source: Arc color field: a swatch whose box grows into the full picker (a clipped reveal on a spring, its shadow following the shape). Pick saturation and brightness on the area, hue and opacity on the sliders, or type a value in hex, RGB, HSL or OKLCH; the format button morphs its label and the value between formats. A contrast readout counts to the WCAG ratio against `ContrastBackground` with its grade, and saved swatches pop in, reorder by drag or Alt + arrows and go with Delete. Arrow keys move every thumb (Shift and Page keys by ten); Escape drops a draft, then closes and returns focus. The eyedropper is not offered: Avalonia has no cross-platform screen color API.
trans-unit.target: Arc 色彩欄位：色塊的外框會展開為完整的調色器（以彈簧形式裁切顯現，陰影隨形狀變化）。在面板上選取飽和度與亮度，在滑桿上選取色相與不透明度，或以 hex、RGB、HSL 或 OKLCH 輸入數值；格式按鈕會將標籤與數值在各格式之間變形切換。對比度讀數會計數到相對於 `ContrastBackground` 的 WCAG 比率並給出等級；已儲存的色票會彈出顯示，可拖曳或按 Alt + 方向鍵重新排序，按 Delete 刪除。方向鍵移動所有滑桿（Shift 與 Page 鍵以十為單位）；Escape 先捨棄草稿，再關閉並將焦點交還。不提供滴管工具：Avalonia 沒有跨平台的螢幕取色 API。

trans-unit.source: Text after the contrast ratio that compares the color with the background (default "against background").
trans-unit.target: 對比度數值之後的文字，用於比較顏色與背景（預設為 “against background”）。

trans-unit.source: The color (two-way). Arc's default is #2F6BFF.
trans-unit.target: 顏色（雙向繫結）。Arc 的預設值為 #2F6BFF。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Color` changes.
trans-unit.target: `Color` 變更時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The background the color will sit on, for the contrast readout (Arc: white).
trans-unit.target: 此顏色將置於其上的背景，用於對比度讀數（Arc 為白色）。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the swatch.
trans-unit.target: 色票下方的輔助說明文字。

trans-unit.source: Label of the Done button that closes the panel (default "Done").
trans-unit.target: 關閉面板的完成按鈕的標籤（預設為「完成」）。

trans-unit.source: Arc combobox: a searchable single-choice field. trans-unit.source: Arc command palette: the keyboard entry point to product-wide actions and navigation. A search field over grouped results with icons, descriptions and shortcut caps. Typing filters the commands (label, description, group and keywords); ↓ / ↑ / Home / End move one shared highlight (a 70ms slide for keys, a snappy spring for the pointer), Enter runs the highlighted command (or, after typing, the top match), Escape clears the query and then raises `CloseRequested`. Cmd/Ctrl+K anywhere in the window focuses the field. While filtering, the remaining rows glide into place and the results frame springs to the new height. Only the rows near the visible part of the list exist, so a thousand commands cost the same as ten. The control itself is inline, like Arc's: it does not open or close. For a popup that opens on Cmd+K (or from a button) over the page and closes with a key, use `CommandPaletteDialog`, which hosts a palette. Ported from Arc's free command-palette block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli).
trans-unit.target: Arc 指令面板：面向全產品操作與導覽的鍵盤入口。搜尋欄位之下是帶圖示、描述與快速鍵鍵帽的分組結果。輸入會篩選指令（標題、描述、群組與關鍵字）；↓ / ↑ / Home / End 移動同一個共用醒目提示（按鍵使用 70ms 滑動，指標使用靈敏彈簧），Enter 執行醒目提示的指令（輸入後則執行排在最前的符合項），Escape 清除查詢，隨後引發 `CloseRequested`。視窗內任意位置按 Cmd/Ctrl+K 會聚焦搜尋欄位。篩選時，保留的列平滑滑到新位置，結果外框透過彈簧過渡到新高度。只有清單可見部分附近的列真實存在，因此一千個指令的開銷與十個相同。該控制項本身是內嵌的，與 Arc 一致：它不負責開啟或關閉。若需要按 Cmd+K（或點按按鈕）在頁面上方開啟、並可用按鍵關閉的彈出層，請使用承載面板的 `CommandPaletteDialog`。移植自 Arc 的免費 command-palette 區塊（MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli）。

trans-unit.source: The command palette as a popup: declare it once and it opens a `CommandPalette` above the page on Cmd+K (Ctrl+K elsewhere) or from a button, and closes it with a key. It renders nothing in place; while `IsOpen` is true it shows the palette near the top centre of the window over a dimmed scrim. Keys: the open gesture (`OpenGesture`) toggles it from anywhere in the window; ↓ ↑ Home End move the highlight, Enter runs the highlighted command (or the top match after typing), Escape clears the query and, in an empty field, closes. A press on the scrim, a click on the "Esc" key cap and choosing a command also close it (`CloseOnOutsidePress`, `CloseOnSelect`); focus returns to what had it before. The palette is built the first time the dialog opens and reused after that; while the dialog is closed it only listens for the open gesture. It is mounted by Core `ModalPresence` (scrim fade, focus trap, stacking with other modals) and rises 6px on the smooth spring (reduced motion: fade only, Off: instant).
trans-unit.target: 以彈出層呈現的指令面板：只需宣告一次，它就會在按下 Cmd+K（其他平台為 Ctrl+K）或點按按鈕時，在頁面上方開啟一個 `CommandPalette`，並可用按鍵關閉。它在原位不轉譯任何內容；`IsOpen` 為 true 時，它會在視窗頂部置中附近、淡淡的遮罩之上顯示面板。按鍵：開啟手勢（`OpenGesture`）可在視窗中任意位置切換它；↓ ↑ Home End 移動醒目提示，Enter 執行醒目提示的指令（輸入後則執行排在最前的符合項），Escape 清除查詢，搜尋欄位為空時則關閉。點按遮罩、點按 “Esc” 鍵帽以及選擇指令同樣會關閉它（`CloseOnOutsidePress`、`CloseOnSelect`）；焦點會回到先前擁有焦點的元素。面板在對話方塊第一次開啟時建立並重複使用；對話方塊關閉期間只處理開啟手勢。它由 Core 的 `ModalPresence` 掛載（遮罩淡入、焦點陷阱、與其他模態層堆疊），並沿平滑彈簧上移 6px（Reduced：僅淡入淡出；Off：立即顯示）。

trans-unit.source: Backdrop blur radius in px applied to the page while the scrim is shown (default 0: none; Arc's dialog uses 7). Off under the ReduceTransparency token.

trans-unit.source: A threaded discussion (Arc's Comment thread): replies nest under their comment and collapse, reactions toggle with a count that rolls, authors edit and delete their own comments in place, mentions autocomplete in the composer, and resolving folds the whole thread into a single chip that reopens it. Use it for review discussions on documents, designs, tickets or pull requests; use `MentionInput` when only the input is needed.
trans-unit.target: 串接式討論（Arc 的留言串）：回覆巢狀排列在其所屬留言之下並可摺疊，表情回應以計數切換（計數滾動變化），作者可原地編輯與刪除自己的留言，@提及在撰寫框中自動補全，標記為已解決時整個串會摺疊為一個標籤，按一下即可重新開啟。適用於文件、設計稿、工單或提取要求上的審閱討論；如果只需要輸入部分，請使用 `MentionInput`。

trans-unit.source: The comments, oldest first (two way). Each change replaces it with the next tree.
trans-unit.target: 留言清單，最早的在前（雙向繫結）。每次變更都會以下一棵樹取代它。

trans-unit.source: A button for destructive or important actions that asks in place: pressing it morphs the same pill into an inline question with Cancel and Confirm, then into a spinner, then into a result with Undo. Only the pill's width moves (growing on the morph spring, shrinking on smooth, P5 / P9); each face sits at its natural width and its parts clear a small blur in reading order (P20) while the old face fades (P2). Unanswered questions and results time out on a pausable timer (P22, held while the pointer rests on the control), Escape and an outside press return it to rest, and focus follows the morph. Answer with a press, a hold, or a press followed by a short countdown.
trans-unit.target: 用於破壞性或重要動作的按鈕，會就地詢問：按下後，同一個膠囊會變形為帶「取消」與「確認」的內嵌問題，接著變為載入指示器，再變為帶「復原」的結果。只有膠囊的寬度會變化（展開時使用變形彈簧，收縮時使用平滑動畫，P5 / P9）；每個介面都保持自然寬度，其各部分依閱讀順序清除小幅模糊（P20），舊介面同時淡出（P2）。未作答的問題與結果會在可暫停的計時器上逾時（P22，指標停留在控制項上時暫停），Escape 鍵與外部按壓會使其回到靜止狀態，焦點隨變形移動。可以一次按壓、一次長按，或按壓後接一段短倒數來作答。

trans-unit.source: Label of the cancel button (default "Cancel").
trans-unit.target: 取消按鈕的標籤（預設為「取消」）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a question or countdown is cancelled (Cancel, Escape, outside press, timeout).
trans-unit.target: 問題或倒數計時被取消時觸發（取消、Escape、外部按壓、逾時）。

trans-unit.source: Runs on confirm. A task that has not completed shows the pending face; a fault shows the error face with Retry.

trans-unit.source: Secondary actions kept close to the selected object (Arc context menu). Wraps its `Content` and opens a menu at the pointer on right-click, or under the target (12px in, 8px below) on a plain click, a tap, the ContextMenu key or Shift+F10. The menu grows from the pointer on a snappy spring, rows press with a tint, and it closes on any scroll, resize or outside press instead of repositioning. Avoid it on targets that need their own click. To give any control a right-click menu without wrapping it, attach a surface: `<Border><arc:ContextMenu.Menu><arc:MenuSurface>…</arc:MenuSurface></arc:ContextMenu.Menu></Border>`.
trans-unit.target: 靠近所選物件的次要動作（Arc 內容選單）。包裹其 `Content`，在右鍵時於指標處開啟選單，或在一般按一下、輕觸、ContextMenu 鍵或 Shift+F10 時在目標下方（向內 12px、向下 8px）開啟。選單以輕快的彈簧從指標處展開，選單列按下時會著色，捲動、調整大小或外部按壓時會關閉而不是重新定位。避免用於本身需要按一下功能的目標。若要讓任意控制項擁有右鍵選單而無需包裹，可附加一個表面：`<Border><arc:ContextMenu.Menu><arc:MenuSurface>…</arc:MenuSurface></arc:ContextMenu.Menu></Border>`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the menu closes.
trans-unit.target: 選單關閉時引發。

trans-unit.source: Whether the menu is open; binds two-way by default.
trans-unit.target: 選單是否開啟；預設為雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of both the target and the menu (Arc default: "Context menu").

trans-unit.source: Attaches a right-click (and ContextMenu key / Shift+F10) menu to any control. The surface becomes a `Context` menu unless its variant was set explicitly.

trans-unit.source: Raised when the menu opens.
trans-unit.target: 選單開啟時引發。

trans-unit.source: Whether a plain click or tap on the target opens the menu (Arc: true).
trans-unit.target: 在目標上一般按一下或輕觸是否開啟選單（Arc 為 true）。

trans-unit.source: One group of cookies a visitor can allow or refuse.
trans-unit.target: 訪客可以允許或拒絕的一組 Cookie。

trans-unit.source: Arc cookie consent: a consent bar that morphs into a preferences panel and, once a choice is saved, folds into a small floating button that reopens it. One surface springs between the three shapes. Optional categories start off, refusing is as easy as accepting, and the choice is reported through `ConsentChanged` and can be remembered (`StorageKey`, read back with `Read`). The control is a layer: place it over the page (for example as the last child of the window's root grid, or of a preview panel); it lets clicks through everywhere except on its surface, which hangs 16px from the bottom.
trans-unit.target: Arc Cookie 同意元件：一個同意列，可變形為偏好設定面板；儲存選擇後，會收合為一個小型浮動按鈕，用於重新開啟面板。同一個表面在三種形態之間以彈簧動畫切換。選用類別預設關閉，拒絕與接受同樣簡單；選擇結果透過 `ConsentChanged` 回報，並可被記住（`StorageKey`，以 `Read` 讀回）。此元件是一個覆蓋層：將其放在頁面之上（例如作為視窗根 Grid 或預覽面板的最後一個子元素）；除表面本身外，點擊都會穿透此元件，表面距底部 16px。

trans-unit.source: The saved choice (category id → allowed); null means the visitor has not decided. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 已儲存的選擇（類別 ID → 是否允許）；null 表示訪客尚未做出決定。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a choice is made or reset.

trans-unit.source: Whether the preferences panel is open. Two-way.

trans-unit.source: Link to the full policy, shown in the bar and the panel.

trans-unit.source: Where the bar sits (default bottom, centered).
trans-unit.target: 同意列的位置（預設為底部置中）。

trans-unit.source: Corner of the reopen button; null follows the bar (left when the bar is centered).
trans-unit.target: 重新開啟按鈕所在的角落；null 時跟隨同意列（同意列置中時為左側）。

trans-unit.source: Where the choice is stored; null uses `Default`.
trans-unit.target: 選擇的儲存位置；null 時使用 `Default`。

trans-unit.source: Remembers the choice under this key (see `Read`).
trans-unit.target: 以此鍵記住選擇（參見 `Read`）。

trans-unit.source: Bump when categories or the policy change to ask again (default "1").
trans-unit.target: 當類別或政策變更時遞增版本號，以便重新詢問（預設為 "1"）。

trans-unit.source: Copies a value with immediate, in-place confirmation: the icon swaps to a hand-drawn check, the label morphs to "Copied", and everything returns to idle after 1.9s. The label cell reserves its widest state so the button never changes width.
trans-unit.target: 複製一個值，並即時原位確認：圖示切換為手繪勾號，文字變形為「已複製」，1.9 秒後全部恢復為閒置狀態。標籤儲存格會預留最寬狀態的空間，因此按鈕寬度不會變化。

trans-unit.source: Occurs after the value is copied to the clipboard.

trans-unit.target: 複製成功後顯示的標籤（預設為「已複製」）。

trans-unit.source: Time the button keeps the copied or error state before it returns to idle (default 1.9 seconds).

trans-unit.source: Current copy state: Idle, Copied or Error (read-only).

trans-unit.source: Text copied to the clipboard when the button is clicked.
trans-unit.target: 點擊按鈕時複製到剪貼簿的文字。

trans-unit.source: Visual style: Outline (default) or Plain.
trans-unit.target: 視覺樣式：Outline（預設）或 Plain。

trans-unit.source: Counts down to a fixed moment, or through a duration, with rolling digit wheels (Arc Countdown), and morphs into a live label at zero. The clock ticks just after each whole second, only while the countdown is on screen; a separate `PausableTimer` makes `Completed` land on time even while ticking is paused. A `Duration` countdown can be paused and resumed (`IsPaused`, `Pause`, `Resume`); a `Target` countdown counts to a fixed instant, so pausing only freezes the display. Wheels turn the short way round; the shell springs to the size of whatever it holds.
trans-unit.target: 倒數至一個固定時刻，或在一段時長內倒數，以滾動數字輪顯示（Arc Countdown），歸零時變形為即時標籤。時鐘僅在倒數計時顯示於畫面上時，於每個整秒之後稍後滴答；獨立的 `PausableTimer` 使 `Completed` 即使在暫停滴答時也能準時觸發。`Duration` 倒數計時可暫停與恢復（`IsPaused`、`Pause`、`Resume`）；`Target` 倒數計時則倒數至一個固定時刻，因此暫停只會凍結顯示。數字輪沿最短路徑轉動；外殼會彈簧式地調整為所容納內容的尺寸。

trans-unit.source: Shown once the countdown reaches zero, beside a pulsing live dot (Arc `completeLabel`, "Live now").
trans-unit.target: 倒數計時歸零後顯示，位於脈動的即時圓點旁（Arc `completeLabel`，「Live now」）。

trans-unit.source: Raised once, the moment the countdown reaches zero while it is shown.
trans-unit.target: 在倒數計時顯示期間剛好歸零的那一刻引發，僅引發一次。

trans-unit.source: Counts down this long from when the countdown is shown (or restarted); pausable.
trans-unit.target: 從倒數計時顯示（或重新開始）時起倒數這麼長時間；可暫停。

trans-unit.source: True once the countdown has reached zero.
trans-unit.target: 倒數計時一旦歸零即為 true。

trans-unit.source: Pauses a duration countdown (remaining time is kept); freezes the display of a target countdown.
trans-unit.target: 暫停時長倒數計時（保留剩餘時間）；凍結目標倒數計時的顯示。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name (Arc `label`, "Time remaining").
trans-unit.target: 無障礙名稱（Arc `label`，「Time remaining」）。

trans-unit.source: Time left, read from the clock on every tick.
trans-unit.target: 剩餘時間，每次滴答時從時鐘讀取。

trans-unit.source: The moment to count down to. Takes precedence over `Duration`.
trans-unit.target: 倒數至的時刻。優先於 `Duration`。

trans-unit.source: Clock source; pass a server-synced provider when device time cannot be trusted.
trans-unit.target: 時鐘來源；當裝置時間不可信時，傳入與伺服器同步的提供程式。

trans-unit.source: Units to show, largest first; the largest absorbs the rest. Defaults to days through seconds.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的單位，由大到小排列；最大的單位吸收其餘部分。預設為天至秒。

trans-unit.source: Large display digits with unit names (default) or one compact pill.
trans-unit.target: 帶單位名稱的大型顯示數字（預設），或緊湊的單一膠囊。

trans-unit.source: A customer galaxy: every account a dot, its area by monthly recurring revenue and its color by health, slowly turning as a tilted two-armed spiral. Group the accounts by any dimension and the dots spring into one packed cluster per value, labelled with its MRR and size; pan, zoom about the pointer, double-click a cluster to fly into it, hover a dot for its card and click it to select it. A totals panel beside the stage (under it in narrow containers) shows the MRR, accounts, growing and at-risk MRR of everything or of the focused cluster, and a list of the clusters by MRR or by accounts whose rows fly to their cluster.
trans-unit.target: 客戶星系：每個帳戶是一個點，面積由月度經常性收入（MRR）決定，顏色由健康度決定，以傾斜的雙臂螺旋緩慢旋轉。依任意維度將帳戶分組後，這些點會彈跳聚合成每個分組值對應的一個緊密叢集，並標示其 MRR 與規模；可平移、以指標為中心縮放、雙擊叢集飛入其中，懸停點可查看其卡片，點選即可選取。舞台旁（窄容器中在其下方）是彙總面板，顯示全部或所選叢集的 MRR、帳戶數、成長與風險 MRR，以及依 MRR 或帳戶數排序的叢集清單，清單中各列可飛至對應叢集。

trans-unit.target: 使用鍵盤選取帳戶時播報：`{0}` 為名稱，`{1}` 為 MRR，`{2}` 為健康度，`{3}` 為負責人，`{4}` 為備註。

trans-unit.source: An animated data pipeline: events leave their sources, queue up in an event stream, are validated and enriched in batches (some are filtered out) and land in a warehouse, with part of them pushed to live dashboards. Readouts show throughput and what has been stored.
trans-unit.target: 動畫資料管線：事件從各來源送出，在事件串流中排隊，分批驗證並豐富化（部分事件會被過濾掉），最後存入資料倉儲，其中一部分會推送到即時儀表板。讀數顯示吞吐量與已儲存的數量。

trans-unit.source: How many events per second the sources emit (1–60).
trans-unit.target: 來源每秒送出的事件數（1–60）。

trans-unit.source: Share of events the transform filters out (0–0.5).
trans-unit.target: 轉換步驟過濾掉的事件比例（0–0.5）。

trans-unit.source: Node titles, details and caption text of the diagram; set it to rename or translate the scene.
trans-unit.target: 圖示的節點標題、詳細資訊與說明文字；設定此項即可重新命名或翻譯場景。

trans-unit.source: The event sources (1–4); defaults to a web app, a mobile app and webhooks.
trans-unit.target: 事件來源（1–4）；預設為網頁應用程式、行動應用程式和 Webhook。

trans-unit.source: Every visible word of a `DataFlow` (override for another language or domain).
trans-unit.target: `DataFlow` 中所有可見的文字（可覆寫，以用於其他語言或領域）。

trans-unit.source: A spreadsheet grid for editing tabular data in place: range selection, a fill handle, Excel and Google Sheets clipboard, undo, multi-column sort, a filter row and quick search, pinned and hidden columns, row checks with bulk actions, a totals row, grouping with subtotals, CSV and Excel export, and rows and columns that render only while in view. Every piece of view state (sort, filters, search, checked rows, hidden and pinned columns, density, grouping) is a two-way property, so it works bound or left to the grid. Rows come from `ItemsSource` (`DataGridRow` objects or any class read through column bindings or accessors), or block by block from a `DataSource`. Edits write back into the row items and raise `CellsChanged`; editing never re-sorts or re-filters, so rows never jump under the cursor.
trans-unit.target: 就地編輯表格資料的試算表式表格：範圍選取、填滿控點、與 Excel 和 Google 試算表互通的剪貼簿、復原、多欄排序、篩選列和快速搜尋、固定與隱藏欄、列勾選與批次操作、總計列、分組小計、CSV 與 Excel 匯出，列和欄只在可見時繪製。所有檢視狀態（排序、篩選、搜尋、勾選列、隱藏和固定的欄、列密度、分組）都是雙向屬性，既可以繫結，也可以交給表格自行管理。列來自 `ItemsSource`（`DataGridRow` 物件，或透過欄的繫結或存取函式讀取的任意類別），或者透過 `DataSource` 分塊載入。編輯會寫回列物件並引發 `CellsChanged`；編輯不會重新排序或篩選，列不會在游標下跳動。

trans-unit.source: The active cell (display row and visible column), or null when the grid has no cells.
trans-unit.target: 作用中的儲存格（顯示列號與可見欄序號）；表格沒有儲存格時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a bulk action is clicked (its command runs too).
trans-unit.target: 按下批次操作時引發（它的命令也會執行）。

trans-unit.source: Shows Delete for checked rows; deleting can be undone.
trans-unit.target: 為勾選的列顯示「刪除」；刪除可以復原。

trans-unit.source: Decides per cell whether it can be edited, on top of `IsEditable` (for example locking the rows of closed deals). Edits, pastes, fills and clears skip cells it refuses. Keep it cheap: it runs for every cell a write touches.
trans-unit.target: 在欄的 `IsEditable` 之外，逐一儲存格決定能否編輯（例如鎖定已結案交易的列）。編輯、貼上、填滿和清除會略過它拒絕的儲存格。請保持輕量：每次寫入涉及的每個儲存格都會執行它。

trans-unit.source: Shows Add row in the toolbar and allows `AddRow` and `InsertRow` (Ctrl+Shift+Plus inserts above the active row). Needs an `ItemsSource` that is a writable list, and either `DataGridRow` rows or a `RowFactory`. Added rows can be undone. Default false.
trans-unit.target: 在工具列顯示「新增列」，並允許呼叫 `AddRow` 和 `InsertRow`（Ctrl+Shift+加號在作用列上方插入）。需要可寫入清單的 `ItemsSource`，以及 `DataGridRow` 列或 `RowFactory`。新增的列可以復原。預設 false。

trans-unit.source: Whether there is a step to redo.
trans-unit.target: 是否有可重做的步驟。

trans-unit.source: Whether there is a step to undo.
trans-unit.target: 是否有可復原的步驟。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a body cell is pressed with the primary button, after the selection moved (or when a renderer took the press).

trans-unit.source: Raised on a double click or double tap of a body cell, before the editor opens; set `Handled` to keep the editor from opening.

trans-unit.source: Picks a tone for a cell from its row and value, for looks the column's `FormatRules` cannot express. It runs for every cell in view on every frame, so keep it cheap; null from it falls through to the format rules.
trans-unit.target: 根據儲存格所在的列和值為它選擇色調，用於欄的 `FormatRules` 無法表達的外觀。它每一影格都會為檢視區內的每個儲存格執行，所以請保持輕量；回傳 null 時交給格式規則處理。

trans-unit.source: Raised after an edit, paste, cut, clear, fill, fill down, undo or redo wrote cells.
trans-unit.target: 編輯、貼上、剪下、清除、填滿、向下填滿、復原或重做寫入儲存格後引發。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the checked rows, in data order (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 勾選列的鍵，依資料順序（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Column keys in display order (people drag headers, or press Alt+Shift+arrows in one, to change it). Columns not listed follow in their defined order; null keeps the defined order. Pinned columns still come first. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 依顯示順序排列的欄索引鍵（使用者拖曳表頭，或在表頭上按 Alt+Shift+方向鍵來改變它）。未列出的欄依定義順序排在後面；為 null 時保持定義順序。固定欄仍然排在最前。雙向。

trans-unit.source: The widths people set by dragging, double clicking or pressing Alt+arrows on a header, by column key. Two-way.

trans-unit.source: Raised before the built-in menu opens, so the entries can be changed or the menu cancelled.

trans-unit.target: 格式化和解析值所用的文化；為 null 時跟隨 AtomUI 的語言。

trans-unit.source: Loads rows from a server one block at a time as people scroll, instead of `ItemsSource`. The grid is then read only, does not group, hides Select all and exports only checked rows.

trans-unit.target: 只符合大小寫相同的文字（預設 false）。
