trans-unit.source: Fixes the bottom of the value axis (default: zero, or the data minimum when it dips below).
trans-unit.target: 固定數值軸的底端（預設：零；若資料最小值低於零，則為資料最小值）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the cell as an accent-colored link with an underline that strengthens on hover. A click on the text raises `CellInvoked` with `Part`; the cell is not selected by that click.
trans-unit.target: 把儲存格顯示為強調色連結，底線在滑鼠移上時加深。點擊文字會以 `Part` 觸發 `CellInvoked`；該次點擊不會選取儲存格。

trans-unit.source: An Arc-styled Markdown document rendered by StreamMark: headings, lists, tables, quotes, links, inline code and fenced code highlighted in Arc's syntax palette. Show static text with `Text`, or stream a reply with `Append` / `Complete` (or your own `Stream`). The document grows with its content (no internal scrolling); put long documents in a `ScrollViewer`.
trans-unit.target: 由 StreamMark 渲染的 Arc 風格 Markdown 文件：標題、清單、表格、引言、連結、行內程式碼，以及依 Arc 語法配色高亮的圍欄程式碼區塊。使用 `Text` 顯示靜態文字，或使用 `Append` / `Complete`（或你自己的 `Stream`）串流輸出回覆。文件隨內容增長（無內部捲動）；長文件請放入 `ScrollViewer`。

trans-unit.source: Vertical space between blocks (paragraphs, lists, code, tables).
trans-unit.target: 區塊之間的垂直間距（段落、清單、程式碼、表格）。

trans-unit.source: The 0-based index of the current match, or -1 when the search has no match.
trans-unit.target: 目前相符項目的序號（從 0 開始），沒有相符項目時為 -1。

trans-unit.source: The current document is parsed and applied, so `GetOutline` and the scroll methods have their final targets. Raised again when a new `Text` or `Stream` becomes ready, and after a new template is applied. Runs on the UI thread.
trans-unit.target: 目前文件已解析並套用，因此 `GetOutline` 與跳轉方法的目標已最終確定。新的 `Text` 或 `Stream` 就緒、以及重新套用範本後再次引發。在 UI 執行緒上執行。

trans-unit.source: True when the document has a selection, so a copy action can be enabled.
trans-unit.target: 文件有選取範圍時為 true，可用於啟用複製操作。

trans-unit.source: True when the current document has been parsed and the result is applied to the view, so the outline, the search matches and the scroll targets are final. A static `Text` becomes ready once; a stream becomes ready when it completes. False before the template is applied and while a new source is being parsed.
trans-unit.target: 目前文件已解析且結果已套用到檢視時為 true，此時大綱、尋找相符項目與跳轉目標均已最終確定。靜態 `Text` 就緒一次；串流在結束時就緒。範本尚未套用時、以及新來源正在解析期間為 false。

trans-unit.source: Whether `Append` paces the text (true, the default: it is released in small steps that follow the arrival rate). False shows every appended piece as one batch at once: the host has already paced it, for example in whole words on a fixed clock.
trans-unit.target: `Append` 是否依節奏釋出文字（true，預設值：文字以小步釋出，並跟隨到達速率）。為 false 時，每次附加的內容都會一次整體顯示：宿主已自行依節奏處理，例如以固定時鐘逐個顯示完整單字。

trans-unit.source: Whether a stream is attached and has not completed yet.
trans-unit.target: 是否已附加串流且尚未完成。

trans-unit.source: Body line height in pixels; NaN (default) uses the font size times Arc's prose leading (1.65).
trans-unit.target: 內文行高，單位為像素；NaN（預設）時使用字型大小乘以 Arc 的正文行距（1.65）。

trans-unit.source: A link was clicked (anchors inside the document scroll by themselves and do not arrive here).
trans-unit.target: 連結被點擊時觸發（文件內的錨點會自行捲動，不會傳到這裡）。

trans-unit.source: The number of matches of the last `Find`, 0 when nothing is searched.
trans-unit.target: 最近一次 `Find` 的相符數量，未尋找時為 0。

trans-unit.source: Opens allowed absolute links (http, https, mailto) with the system launcher when no `LinkClicked` handler marks the event handled and the link policy does not ask for confirmation.
trans-unit.target: 在沒有 `LinkClicked` 處理常式將事件標記為已處理，且連結原則不要求確認時，使用系統啟動器開啟允許的絕對連結（http、https、mailto）。

trans-unit.source: How long each batch of text appended with `Append` fades in at full motion; null uses Arc's standard duration. A host that paces the text itself usually sets 150 ms.
trans-unit.target: 透過 `Append` 附加的每批文字以完整動效淡入所需的時長；為 null 時使用 Arc 的標準時長。宿主自行控制節奏時通常設為 150 ms。

trans-unit.source: Whether appended text still fades in at reduced motion (a short opacity fade). False shows it at once, which suits a reply that grows continuously: there is no whole to fade.
trans-unit.target: 透過 `Append` 附加的文字在減少動效時是否仍淡入（短暫的不透明度漸變）。為 false 時立即顯示，適合持續增長的回覆：此時沒有完整的整體可供淡入。

trans-unit.source: The matches or the current match of `Find` changed (including when the document changes under a search and the query is run again). Runs on the UI thread.
trans-unit.target: `Find` 的相符項目或目前相符項目發生變化（包括尋找期間文件變更、查詢重新執行）。在 UI 執行緒上執行。

trans-unit.source: The selection of the document view changed; `HasSelection` and the copy results follow.
trans-unit.target: 文件檢視的選取範圍發生變化；`HasSelection` 與複製結果隨之更新。

trans-unit.source: StreamMark services (plugins, code block options, link policy). Null uses services set on an ancestor with `MarkdownServices.SetServices`, else `DefaultServices`.
trans-unit.target: StreamMark 服務（外掛程式、程式碼區塊選項、連結原則）。為 null 時使用祖先元素上透過 `MarkdownServices.SetServices` 設定的服務，否則使用 `DefaultServices`。

trans-unit.source: A streamed reply to show instead of `Text`. `Append` creates one when none is set; you can also supply your own (for example one fed from a worker thread with `Push`).
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的串流回覆，代替 `Text`。未設定時，`Append` 會建立一個；你也可以提供自己的串流（例如透過 `Push` 從工作執行緒供給的串流）。

trans-unit.source: The Markdown source to show. Setting it ends a stream started with `Append`.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的 Markdown 原始文字。設定此屬性會結束由 `Append` 開始的串流。

trans-unit.source: Fails text longer than `Length` characters.
trans-unit.target: 文字長度超過 `Length` 個字元時不通過。

trans-unit.source: A filing group of memories (About you, Preferences, Projects, People by default).
trans-unit.target: 記憶的一個歸檔群組（預設為「關於你」「偏好」「專案」「人物」）。

trans-unit.source: The sentence shown in the group when it has no memories while it is the only group on screen.
trans-unit.target: 當該群組是畫面上唯一的群組、且其中沒有記憶時，在群組中顯示的文字。

trans-unit.source: The key a memory's `GroupKey` refers to.
trans-unit.target: 記憶的 `GroupKey` 所指向的鍵。

trans-unit.source: The label of the filter pill and the group heading.
trans-unit.target: 篩選膠囊與群組標題的標籤。

trans-unit.source: One thing the assistant remembers about the person. Data only: an `AvaloniaObject` so that the properties bind and a change (an edit from elsewhere) reaches the row on screen.
trans-unit.target: 助手對使用者記住的一件事。僅為資料：它是一個 `AvaloniaObject`，因此屬性可以繫結，其他地方的變更（例如編輯）也能同步到畫面上的列。

trans-unit.source: The key of the `MemoryGroup` the memory is filed under.
trans-unit.target: 該記憶所歸入的 `MemoryGroup` 的鍵。

trans-unit.source: Stable id, unique within `Memories`.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id，在 `Memories` 內唯一。

trans-unit.source: The avatar image for `PersonName`; without one the avatar shows the first letter.
trans-unit.target: `PersonName` 的頭像圖片；沒有圖片時，頭像顯示名字的首字母。

trans-unit.source: When set (the memory is about a person), the row shows a small avatar and this name is its accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 設定後（記憶與某人有關），該列會顯示一個小頭像，且此名稱作為其無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The date of the source, shown as a short date such as "Sep 8".
trans-unit.target: 來源的日期，以短日期格式顯示，例如「Sep 8」。

trans-unit.source: Whether the memory came from a chat or was added by the person.
trans-unit.target: 該記憶來自聊天，還是由使用者手動新增。

trans-unit.source: When set, the source text is a link: `SourceRequested` reports it.
trans-unit.target: 設定後，來源文字即為連結：`SourceRequested` 會回報該連結。

trans-unit.source: The memory as one sentence without a final period, such as "Prefers tables to long bullet lists".
trans-unit.target: 記憶內容，為一個不含句末句號的句子，例如「偏好表格勝過長條列表」。

trans-unit.source: A channel offered after `#`.
trans-unit.target: 在 `#` 之後提供的頻道。

trans-unit.source: Arc's Mention input: an auto-growing text field with `@` people and `#` channel mentions that act as single tokens, with suggestions at the caret. The value is plain text plus structured mentions with offsets (`MentionValue`), ready to store (`MentionSerializer`) or to notify by id.
trans-unit.target: Arc 提及輸入框：自動增高的文字欄位，支援 `@` 人員與 `#` 頻道提及，提及項目會作為單一權杖處理，並在插入點顯示建議。值包括純文字以及帶位移量的結構化提及（`MentionValue`），可直接儲存（`MentionSerializer`）或依 ID 發送通知。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Channels` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Channels` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ChannelsListName` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ChannelsListName` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsSubmitOnEnter` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IsSubmitOnEnter` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsSuggestionsOpen` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IsSuggestionsOpen` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Label` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Label` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `MaxLines` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `MaxLines` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `MaxSuggestions` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `MaxSuggestions` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a suggestion becomes a mention (Arc `onMentionAdd`).
trans-unit.target: 當一個建議變為提及項目時引發（Arc `onMentionAdd`）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Mentions` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Mentions` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `MinLines` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `MinLines` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `NoChannelsMatchFormat` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `NoChannelsMatchFormat` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `NoMatchesText` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `NoMatchesText` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `NoPeopleMatchFormat` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `NoPeopleMatchFormat` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `People` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `People` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `PeopleListName` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `PeopleListName` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Placeholder` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Placeholder` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `SubmitCommand` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `SubmitCommand` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Enter submits (with `IsSubmitOnEnter`, Arc `onSubmit`).
trans-unit.target: 按下 Enter 提交時引發（配合 `IsSubmitOnEnter`，對應 Arc `onSubmit`）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `SuggestionPlacement` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `SuggestionPlacement` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Value` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Value` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Raised after `Value` changed (typing, choosing, programmatic).
trans-unit.target: `Value` 變更後引發（輸入、選取或程式設定均會觸發）。

trans-unit.source: A person offered after `@`.
trans-unit.target: 在 `@` 之後提供的人員。

trans-unit.source: One row of a `MenuSurface`: a leading icon (a Lucide `Geometry` such as `{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}`, or any control), a header, an optional shortcut hint and the check or radio indicator of toggle rows. Rows never draw their own hover or focus fill: the surface's shared highlight glides to the row under the pointer and jumps to the keyboard position. Activation runs `Command`, raises `Click` and the surface's `ItemClicked`, then closes the menu unless `StaysOpenOnClick` is set.
trans-unit.target: `MenuSurface` 中的一列：前置圖示（Lucide `Geometry`，例如 `{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}`，或任意控制項）、標題、可選的快速鍵提示，以及切換列的勾選或單選指示器。各列不繪製自己的懸停或焦點填色：由選單面板共用的反白會滑動到指標所在的列，並跳到鍵盤所在的位置。啟動時會執行 `Command`、引發 `Click` 與選單面板的 `ItemClicked`，然後關閉選單，除非設定了 `StaysOpenOnClick`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the row is activated (pointer release, Enter or Space), before the menu closes.
trans-unit.target: 列被啟動（指標放開、Enter 或空白鍵）時引發，發生在選單關閉之前。

trans-unit.source: Command run when the row is activated; the row is disabled while the command cannot execute.
trans-unit.target: 列被啟動時執行的命令；命令無法執行時此列會被停用。

trans-unit.source: Parameter passed to Command when the row is activated.
trans-unit.target: 列被啟動時傳遞給 Command 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Radio rows with the same group name (within one surface) are mutually exclusive.
trans-unit.target: 同一群組名稱（在同一選單面板內）的單選列互斥。

trans-unit.source: Draws a separator line above the row (Arc's `separatorBefore`).
trans-unit.target: 在列的上方繪製分隔線（Arc 的 `separatorBefore`）。

trans-unit.source: The row label (strings ellipsize; any content is accepted). Also the typeahead text unless `TextSearch.Text` is set.
trans-unit.target: 列的標籤（字串會被省略截斷，也可接受任意內容）。除非設定了 `TextSearch.Text`，否則它也是輸入搜尋的文字。

trans-unit.source: Data template that renders the header; without one, a string header is drawn as ellipsizing text.
trans-unit.target: 渲染標題的資料範本；未設定時，字串標題會以省略號截斷的文字繪製。

trans-unit.source: Leading icon: a 24x24 Lucide `Geometry` (drawn as a 16px stroke glyph) or any control.
trans-unit.target: 前置圖示：24x24 的 Lucide `Geometry`（繪製為 16px 描邊圖示）或任意控制項。

trans-unit.source: Shortcut shown as a quiet hint at the row end (display only; bind the key with a hot key yourself).
trans-unit.target: 顯示在列末端的快速鍵提示（僅用於顯示；快速鍵需自行以熱鍵繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Free-form shortcut hint (for example "⌘ ,"); wins over `InputGesture`.
trans-unit.target: 自由格式的快速鍵提示（例如 “⌘ ,”）；優先於 `InputGesture`。

trans-unit.source: Checked state (two-way). Rows without an icon show a check (or a dot for radio rows) when checked.
trans-unit.target: 勾選狀態（雙向繫結）。沒有圖示的列在選取時顯示勾選標記（單選列顯示圓點）。

trans-unit.source: Danger text and icon, and a danger-tinted highlight. Put destructive rows last and name what they destroy.
trans-unit.target: 危險文字與圖示，並使用危險色調的反白。破壞性列應放在最後，並寫明將被破壞的對象。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the menu open after activation (toggles that people flip several times).
trans-unit.target: 啟動後保持選單開啟（適用於需要多次切換的開關）。

trans-unit.source: How the row toggles when activated: None for a command row, CheckBox, or Radio.
trans-unit.target: 列被啟動時的切換方式：None（命令列）、CheckBox 或 Radio。

trans-unit.source: Inherited from the owning `MenuSurface`; selects the row geometry.
trans-unit.target: 繼承自所屬的 `MenuSurface`；決定列的幾何外觀。

trans-unit.source: Arc metric card: a compact summary for a number that needs context (uptime, orders). The value rolls like an odometer (`AnimatedCounter`, from zero on first view); the label, context and change chip roll in from the side the number moved toward (a larger number rises from below, a smaller one drops from above), and the chip's width springs to fit. A signed change reads its direction in color as well as sign; set `IsChangeGlyphVisible` to add a direction glyph and `Sparkline` for a small trend line.
trans-unit.target: Arc 指標卡片：用於呈現需要上下文的數字的精簡摘要（如運作時間、訂單數）。數值以里程表式滾動（`AnimatedCounter`，首次顯示時從零開始）；標籤、上下文與變化標籤會從數字移動的方向滾入（較大的數字從下方升起，較小的數字從上方落下），標籤寬度以彈簧方式適配內容。帶正負號的變化同時以顏色與正負號指示方向；設定 `IsChangeGlyphVisible` 可加入方向圖示，設定 `Sparkline` 可顯示小型趨勢線。

trans-unit.source: The change chip, such as "+12%"; empty hides the chip. Write the sign: color is not the only cue.
trans-unit.target: 變化標籤，例如 “+12%”；為空時隱藏標籤。請寫明正負號：顏色並非唯一的提示。

trans-unit.source: Direction read from the sign of `Change`.
trans-unit.target: 由 `Change` 的正負號讀取的方向。

trans-unit.source: The comparison line, such as "vs last week".
trans-unit.target: 比較說明列，例如 “較上週”。

trans-unit.source: Fraction digits of the number (default 0).
trans-unit.target: 數字的小數位數（預設 0）。

trans-unit.source: Adds a trending up / down glyph to a signed change chip (default false, like Arc).
trans-unit.target: 在帶正負號的變化標籤上加入上升或下降的趨勢圖示（預設 false，與 Arc 一致）。

trans-unit.source: What is measured.
trans-unit.target: 所衡量的對象。

trans-unit.source: Text before the number, such as "$".
trans-unit.target: 數字前的文字，例如 “$”。

trans-unit.source: Optional values for a small trend line beside the number.
trans-unit.target: 可選的數值，用於在數字旁繪製小型趨勢線。

trans-unit.source: Unit after the number, such as "%" or " ms".
trans-unit.target: 數字後的單位，例如 “%” 或 “ ms”。

trans-unit.source: The number; it rolls from zero on first view, then between values.
trans-unit.target: 數值；首次顯示時從零滾動到該值，之後在不同值之間滾動。

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of a sparse mixture-of-experts layer. Tokens enter one at a time; a router scores every expert (a small bar each), the token travels to its top-k experts, which light up in a first and second choice color and count it, and their outputs merge into the token's output chip. Experts have a capacity: a full expert skips the token, and a token whose every choice is full passes through unchanged. The header switches between top 1 and top 2 and shows the parameters that run per token; a load balance bar sits under the stage. Pointing at, focusing or pinning a token or an expert freezes the story on it and shows its route or its load. The routing is computed from the tokens' scores (or stable scores derived from their text); the numbers are illustrative.
trans-unit.target: 稀疏混合專家層的動畫講解。Token 逐一進入；路由器為每位專家評分（每位專家一根小柱），token 被送往其前 top-k 位專家，這些專家以第一和第二選擇顏色亮起並計數，它們的輸出匯入 token 的輸出標籤塊。專家有容量：已滿的專家會略過該 token，所有選擇都已滿的 token 則原樣通過。標題可在 top 1 與 top 2 之間切換，並顯示每個 token 運行的參數；負載平衡條位於舞台下方。指向、聚焦或釘選某個 token 或專家會凍結演示並顯示其路由或負載。路由根據 token 的分數計算（或由其文字推導出的穩定分數）；數字僅為示意。

trans-unit.source: The parameters that run for one token at the current top k, in billions.
trans-unit.target: 在目前 top-k 下，每個 token 運行的參數量（單位：十億）。

trans-unit.source: The tokens each expert takes before it is full, or null when nothing is ever dropped.
trans-unit.target: 每位專家在額滿前可接收的 token 數；若從不捨棄任何 token 則為 null。

trans-unit.source: Scales each expert's capacity, ⌈factor × tokens × k / experts⌉ tokens (default 1). A full expert skips further tokens. `PositiveInfinity` never drops a token; zero, negative and NaN values count as 1.
trans-unit.target: 縮放每位專家的容量，即 ⌈factor × tokens × k / experts⌉ 個 token（預設為 1）。已滿的專家會略過後續的 token。`PositiveInfinity` 從不捨棄 token；零、負數與 NaN 均按 1 計算。

trans-unit.source: The token being routed, or −1 while the summary shows.
trans-unit.target: 正在路由的 token 索引；顯示摘要時為 −1。

trans-unit.source: The experts, 2 to 12 (more are cut to the first 12). Leave it empty, or give fewer than two, for the eight default experts. Changing the experts starts the story over.
trans-unit.target: 專家，數量為 2 到 12（超過 12 個的只取前 12 個）。留空，或給出少於兩個，則使用預設的八位專家。更改專家會重新開始演示。

trans-unit.source: The first choice's color (null: chart series 1, which follows the accent).
trans-unit.target: 第一選擇的顏色（null：圖表系列 1，跟隨強調色）。

trans-unit.source: The expert being inspected (hovered, keyboard-focused or pinned), or −1.
trans-unit.target: 正在檢查（懸停、鍵盤聚焦或釘選）的專家；否則為 −1。

trans-unit.target: `MixtureOfExperts` 顯示或朗讀的每一個文字，預設為英文。替換整個實例即可翻譯或改寫；包含數字或名稱的句子為函數，以便調整詞序。頁尾註解可以包含 `{token}`，它會被替換為一個顯示該 token 文字的小標籤塊。參數數量已格式化後傳入（如 "30"、"2.5"）。

trans-unit.source: How one token was routed: its normalized gate scores, the experts it chose (best first) with their weights within the choice, the chosen experts that were full and skipped it, and the expert loads once it has been routed. trans-unit.target: 一個 token 的路由方式：其標準化的閘控分數、所選專家（依最佳排序）及其在該選擇內的權重、被略過的已滿所選專家，以及該 token 路由後各專家的負載。整個序列一次規劃完成，因此可在 token 播放前閱讀其路由。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Routed`: a token leaves the router for its experts.

trans-unit.source: One token that a `MixtureOfExperts` routes: its text and, optionally, the router's raw score for every expert. (The name ends in Item because `MixtureOfExpertsToken` is the control's design token.)

trans-unit.source: The router's raw score for each expert, in the order of `Experts` ("24, 6, 3, 58" in XAML). Scores are non-negative and are normalized to sum to 1; missing entries count as 0 and extra ones are ignored. Null derives stable example scores from `Text`.

trans-unit.target: 模型所見的 token（保留空格，因此 " the" 與 "the" 是不同的 token）。它顯示在輸入、輸出和序列標籤塊中，並在頁尾中被點名。

trans-unit.target: 標題。開啟時變更它會交叉淡化（新文字帶著輕微模糊升起）。

trans-unit.source: Chooses a model and its reasoning effort from one compact pill. The pill shows the current choice; its menu lists a few featured models with a one-line note each, an effort setting, and every other model grouped by provider. Under the pill a summary shows what the model can hold and costs, and confirms each change for a moment. A composition of `ModelPill`, `ModelMenu` and `ModelSummary`: the catalog, the selection and the effort are properties, so bind them or read them back from the events. The pill opens on a pointer press or on Enter, Space and ArrowDown; the menu has a featured list, an Effort row and a More models row that open submenus (or pages in a narrow window); choosing closes the menu and returns focus to the pill; the effort moves to the nearest level a new model offers. Set `IsSummaryVisible` to false for the pill alone (a toolbar, a header). Screen readers hear a polite announcement after each change ("Now using Aurora Prime 3, medium effort"); the visible confirmation under the summary stays for `NoticeDuration`.
trans-unit.target: 從一個緊湊的膠囊中選擇模型及其推理強度。膠囊顯示目前的選擇；其選單列出數個精選模型（各附一行說明）、一項推理強度設定，以及依提供者分組的所有其他模型。膠囊下方的概覽顯示該模型能容納的內容與費用，並在每次變更後短暫給出確認。它由 `ModelPill`、`ModelMenu` 和 `ModelSummary` 組合而成：目錄、選取與推理強度皆為屬性，因此可以繫結，或從事件中讀回。膠囊在指標按下，或按 Enter、Space 與 ArrowDown 時開啟選單；選單包含精選清單、Effort 列和 More models 列，它們會開啟子選單（視窗較窄時改為頁面）；選擇後選單關閉，焦點回到膠囊；推理強度會移到新模型所提供的最接近的一檔。把 `IsSummaryVisible` 設為 false，就只剩膠囊（用於工具列或頁首）。每次變更後，螢幕閱讀器會聽到一則禮貌式朗讀（"Now using Aurora Prime 3, medium effort"）；概覽下方的確認提示會保留 `NoticeDuration` 的時間。

trans-unit.source: The currency symbol in front of the summary's prices ("$").
trans-unit.target: 概覽中價格前方的貨幣符號（"$"）。

trans-unit.source: The effort (two-way); a level the selected model does not offer moves to the nearest one, and a model without levels has none (null).
trans-unit.target: 推理強度（雙向繫結）；所選模型不提供的等級會移至最接近的等級，沒有等級的模型則為空（null）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the effort changes: a choice in the menu, a snap to a level the new model offers, or code.
trans-unit.target: 推理強度變更時觸發：在選單中選擇、吸附到新模型所提供的等級，或由程式碼觸發。

trans-unit.source: Whether the menu is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 選單是否開啟（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the summary under the pill (default); false leaves the pill alone, for a toolbar or a header.
trans-unit.target: 在膠囊下方顯示概覽（預設）；設為 false 則僅保留膠囊，適用於工具列或標題列。

trans-unit.source: Every word the picker shows or reads out, with English defaults (see `ModelPickerLabels`).
trans-unit.target: 選擇器顯示或朗讀的每個文字，並附英文預設值（參見 `ModelPickerLabels`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the selected model changes, by a choice in the menu or by code.
trans-unit.target: 所選模型變更時觸發，無論是在選單中選擇或由程式碼變更。

trans-unit.source: How long the confirmation under the summary stays after a change (2.6 s); zero shows none.

trans-unit.source: Arc money input: a currency amount field. Digits group as they are typed without moving the caret, the missing cents wait as faint ghosts so the amount never changes width when it settles, long amounts scale down to fit instead of scrolling, and quick add chips and arrow keys roll the digits. A currency menu switches the currency and keeps the major amount. `Value` is the amount in major units (12.5 for $12.50); `MinorUnits` gives the integer minor units Arc reports.
trans-unit.target: Arc 金額輸入框：貨幣金額欄位。數字在輸入時即分組且插入點不移動，未輸入的分值以淡色虛影等待，因此金額穩定後寬度不會改變；過長的金額會縮小以適應而非捲動；快速加入標籤與方向鍵會滾動數字。貨幣選單可切換貨幣並保留主單位金額。`Value` 以主單位表示金額（$12.50 為 12.5）；`MinorUnits` 提供 Arc 回報的整數最小單位。

trans-unit.source: Formatting culture (Arc `locale`): en-US by default, never the current culture.
trans-unit.target: 格式化文化（Arc `locale`）：預設為 en-US，絕不使用目前的系統文化。

trans-unit.source: Codes offered by the currency menu; a single code shows it as static text instead of the menu.
trans-unit.target: 貨幣選單提供的代碼；只有一個代碼時，直接以靜態文字顯示，不顯示選單。

trans-unit.target: 金額的 ISO 4217 代碼（預設 “USD”）。預設為雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the currency changes: a choice in the menu (Arc `onCurrencyChange`) or a programmatic set (`ChangeSource`).
trans-unit.target: 貨幣變更時引發：可能是在選單中的選取（Arc `onCurrencyChange`），也可能是程式設定（`ChangeSource`）。

trans-unit.source: True while the currency menu is open.
trans-unit.target: 貨幣選單開啟時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Highest amount in major units; typing past it is refused with a kick.

trans-unit.source: Quick add chips in major units (10, 50, 100 by default); an empty list hides them.

trans-unit.source: Raised for every real change of `Value`: typing, paste, keys, chips, a currency choice, automation and programmatic sets (`ChangeSource` tells them apart). Never raised during template application.
trans-unit.target: `Value` 每次實際變化時引發：輸入、貼上、按鍵、標籤、貨幣選取、自動化及程式設定均會觸發（`ChangeSource` 用於區分來源）。套用範本期間從不引發。

trans-unit.source: Arc morph select: a select whose trigger is the list. Opening grows the trigger itself into the options surface (width, height and corners spring together, P9), a single highlight glides between options (P7), and the chosen label lifts out of the list and settles into the trigger (P8) while the trigger springs to its new width (P5). Supports groups (`Group`), icons and trailing meta, type-ahead, search for long lists and the full listbox keyboard model. Use it for property pickers and form fields with up to a few hundred options. Keyboard: Enter, Space and the arrows open on the selected option (Home / End open on the first or last); arrows, PageUp / PageDown (8 at a time) and Home / End move; Enter or Space picks; Alt+Up picks and closes; typing jumps (or searches when search is on); Escape closes and returns focus; Tab closes without picking.
trans-unit.target: Arc 變形選擇框：觸發器本身即是清單。開啟時，觸發器會直接變形為選項面板（寬度、高度與圓角一同以彈簧變化，P9），單一反白在選項之間滑動（P7），所選標籤從清單中浮起並落入觸發器（P8），同時觸發器以彈簧變為新寬度（P5）。支援群組（`Group`）、圖示與尾隨中繼資料、輸入搜尋、長清單搜尋以及完整的清單方塊鍵盤操作模型。適用於屬性選擇器以及最多數百個選項的表單欄位。鍵盤：Enter、空白鍵與方向鍵會在所選選項上開啟（Home / End 在第一個或最後一個選項上開啟）；方向鍵、PageUp / PageDown（每次 8 項）與 Home / End 用於移動；Enter 或空白鍵用於選取；Alt+Up 選取並關閉；輸入字元會跳轉（開啟搜尋時則進行搜尋）；Escape 關閉並返回焦點；Tab 關閉且不選取。

trans-unit.source: An animated multi-region deployment: a global load balancer sends users to the primary region while its database replicates to standby regions. When a region fails its health checks traffic shifts to the next healthy region and, if it held the primary database, a replica is promoted; a recovered region catches up as a replica.
trans-unit.target: 動畫示範的多區域部署：全域負載平衡器將使用者導向主要區域，其資料庫同時複寫至備援區域。某區域的健康檢查失敗時，流量會切換至下一個健康區域；若該區域持有主要資料庫，則會將一個副本升格為主要；恢復的區域則以副本身分重新同步。

trans-unit.source: Arc multi-select: pick several values from a fixed list while the field stays one line. Picked values show as chips in the trigger (their slots spring open, the chips grow in out of a blur); past `MaxVisibleChips` they fold into a "+N" chip whose count rolls. Each option's check draws itself. A clear button pops in while anything is selected. Keyboard: Enter or Space opens and closes; arrows open and move the highlight (wrapping, skipping disabled options); Enter toggles the highlighted option; Escape closes. `IsSearchable` adds a search field to the menu (an addition: Arc's menu has none).
trans-unit.target: Arc 多選框：從固定清單中選取多個值，同時欄位保持單行。已選值以標籤形式顯示在觸發器中（其位置以彈簧展開，標籤從模糊中淡入放大）；超過 `MaxVisibleChips` 時，它們會摺疊為一個 “+N” 標籤，其計數會滾動變化。每個選項的勾選標記自行繪製。只要有選取項目，清除按鈕就會彈出。鍵盤：Enter 或空白鍵開啟與關閉；方向鍵開啟並移動反白（循環移動，略過停用的選項）；Enter 切換目前反白的選項；Escape 關閉。`IsSearchable` 會在選單中加入搜尋欄位（這是對 Arc 的補充：Arc 的選單沒有搜尋）。

trans-unit.source: A home for updates: a bell with an unread badge that opens a panel of notifications with read state, an All / Unread switch, expandable details and bulk actions ("Mark all read", "Clear read"). Use it when updates need a persistent place instead of a brief toast, and connect the read state to your data store through `IsRead` and the `ReadChanged` and `Dismissed` events. The panel grows out of the bell (6px toward it at scale 0.97, standard 240ms) and leaves in 120ms; counts roll, the summary rises into its new wording, the view highlight glides on the morph spring, rows collapse their height on the smooth spring as they leave (cascading 35ms apart after a bulk action) and settle in with a 4px rise when the panel opens. Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the bell. Ported from Arc's free notification-center block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli).
trans-unit.target: 更新的常駐入口：一個帶未讀徽章的鈴鐺，點選後開啟通知面板，面板包含已讀狀態、All / Unread 切換、可展開的詳細資料與批次操作（「Mark all read」、「Clear read」）。當更新需要持久的位置，而非短暫的訊息提示時使用，並透過 `IsRead` 與 `ReadChanged` 及 `Dismissed` 事件，將已讀狀態連接到你的資料儲存。面板從鈴鐺處展開（朝鈴鐺方向偏移 6px、縮放至 0.97，標準時長 240ms），並在 120ms 內收合；計數滾動更新，摘要以向上推入的方式切換為新文字，檢視的醒目提示沿變形彈簧滑動，列離開時以平滑彈簧收合高度（批次操作後以 35ms 間隔依序串接），面板開啟時各列以 4px 上升的方式就位。按下 Escape 關閉面板，並將焦點返回鈴鐺。移植自 Arc 免費的通知中心區塊（MIT 授權，版權所有 (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli）。

trans-unit.source: Arc number field: a bounded number with clear increment controls. The value rolls like an odometer, the steppers and ArrowUp / ArrowDown repeat and speed up while held, Shift, PageUp and PageDown take large steps, Home and End jump to the limits, and `IsScrubEnabled` lets the label be dragged sideways. Typing edits a plain draft that applies live while valid and commits on Enter, blur or the next step (snapped to the step grid and clamped). A press past a limit strains the value toward it, shakes the refused stepper and names the limit beside the label (`"Max 10 seats"`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 數字輸入框：帶有明確增減控制項的有界數值。數值以里程表式滾動；步進按鈕及 ArrowUp / ArrowDown 按住時會重複並逐步加速；Shift、PageUp 與 PageDown 以較大步幅調整；Home 與 End 跳到上下限；`IsScrubEnabled` 允許左右拖曳標籤來調整數值。輸入時編輯一份一般草稿：有效時即時套用，並在按下 Enter、失去焦點或執行下一步時確認（會對齊步進網格並限制在範圍內）。按壓超出上下限時，數值會向該限制拉伸，被拒絕的步進按鈕會晃動，並在標籤旁標示該限制（`"Max 10 seats"`）。

trans-unit.source: The frame of a project or record page (Arc page header block): a fixed header with breadcrumbs, a large title with a status badge, a description, a meta row, actions and tabs, over the scrolling body of the selected tab. Scrolling the body past 16px folds the header into a compact bar (the breadcrumbs give way to the title and its status, which scrolls back to the top when chosen); it opens again only near the top (4px), so it never flickers. Secondary actions fold into the "More actions" menu when the breadcrumbs would get less than 240px, and return at 272px. Tab counts roll digit by digit, a 2px indicator glides between tabs, and panels slide in from the side of travel. Breakpoints follow the control's own width: below 560px the padding tightens, the root crumb and the compact badge hide and the title steps down a size; below 460px the primary action shows only its icon. Ported from Arc's free page-header block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli) and made data driven: tabs are `PageHeaderTab` items (or data items with `ItemTemplate` and `ContentTemplate`), actions are `PageHeaderAction`s.
trans-unit.target: 專案或紀錄頁面（Arc 頁首區塊）的框架：固定在頂部的頁首，包含麵包屑、附帶狀態徽章的大型標題、描述、中繼資訊列、操作與標籤，下方為所選標籤的可捲動內文。內文捲動超過 16px 時，頁首收合為精簡列（麵包屑讓位給標題及其狀態；選取標題時會捲回頂部）；只有回到頂部附近（4px 以內）才會再次展開，因此不會閃爍。當麵包屑可用寬度將小於 240px 時，次要操作會收合進「More actions」選單，寬度回到 272px 時再展開。標籤計數逐位滾動，2px 指示條在標籤之間滑動，面板從移動方向的一側滑入。斷點依控制項自身的寬度而定：低於 560px 時內距收緊，根麵包屑與精簡徽章隱藏，標題降一級字級；低於 460px 時主要操作只顯示圖示。移植自 Arc 的免費頁首區塊（MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli），並改為資料驅動：標籤為 `PageHeaderTab` 項目（或帶有 `ItemTemplate` 與 `ContentTemplate` 的資料項目），操作為 `PageHeaderAction`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an action is chosen from its button or the "More actions" menu.
trans-unit.target: 從按鈕或「More actions」選單中選取操作時引發。

trans-unit.source: True while the secondary `Actions` are folded into the "More actions" menu.
trans-unit.target: 次要的 `Actions` 收合進「More actions」選單時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Arc pagination: previous and next buttons around a sliding window of five page buttons and one current-page mark that travels between them on a morph spring. When the window moves, the numbers travel like a belt by the number of slots it moved (smooth spring), entering numbers fade in and leaving ones fade out quickly. `CurrentPage` is 1-based, two-way and clamped to `1..PageCount`; with `ShowBoundaryPages` the first and last pages stay reachable behind an ellipsis.
trans-unit.target: Arc 分頁：上一頁、下一頁按鈕之間是由五個頁碼按鈕組成的滑動視窗，以及一個目前頁標記，它會藉由變形彈簧在各按鈕之間移動。視窗移動時，頁碼會依移動的格數如輸送帶般平移（平滑彈簧）；新出現的頁碼淡入，離開的頁碼快速淡出。`CurrentPage` 從 1 開始計算，為雙向繫結，並限制在 `1..PageCount` 範圍內；啟用 `ShowBoundaryPages` 後，首頁與末頁仍可透過省略號存取。

trans-unit.source: The current page, 1-based. Two-way; values outside `1..PageCount` are clamped for display.
trans-unit.target: 目前頁碼，從 1 開始。雙向繫結；超出 `1..PageCount` 範圍的值在顯示時會被限制。

trans-unit.source: Arc password field: a labeled password input with a reveal toggle inside the frame. The toggle's eye is crossed out by a slash that draws itself (it is never swapped for a second icon), and after the first toggle every switch between dots and characters resolves in place from a light blur. Enter or Space on the toggle shows or hides the password; the toggle reports its pressed state and switches its name between `ShowPasswordText` and `HidePasswordText`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 密碼輸入框：帶標籤的密碼輸入框，外框內有顯示切換按鈕。切換按鈕的眼睛圖示上有一條自行繪製的斜線（從不替換為第二個圖示）；首次切換之後，圓點與字元之間的每次切換都會透過輕微模糊原地過渡。在切換按鈕上按 Enter 或 Space 可顯示或隱藏密碼；該按鈕會回報其按下狀態，並在 `ShowPasswordText` 與 `HidePasswordText` 之間切換其名稱。

trans-unit.source: Name of the toggle while the password is shown.
trans-unit.target: 密碼顯示時切換按鈕的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Shows the password as text (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 以文字形式顯示密碼（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the toggle while the password is hidden.
trans-unit.target: 密碼隱藏時切換按鈕的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Arc password strength: a new-password field that shows how strong the password is while it is typed. Four segments fill in a staggered wave and change tone, the strength word rises when strength improves and drops when it falls, each requirement checks off with a drawn tick (unmet length rules show a rolling "4 more"), and a new `ErrorMessage` shakes the field once. Scoring runs on the device through a pluggable `Scorer` (default: `PasswordStrengthEstimator`, synchronous and cheap).
trans-unit.target: Arc 密碼強度：新密碼輸入框，在輸入時即顯示密碼的強度。四段分段條以交錯波浪的方式填滿並變換色調，強度文字在強度提升時上升、下降時下降；每項要求都會以繪製的勾號逐一打勾（未達成的長度規則會顯示滾動的 "4 more"）；新的 `ErrorMessage` 會讓輸入框晃動一次。評分在本機透過可替換的 `Scorer` 完成（預設：`PasswordStrengthEstimator`，同步且成本低）。

trans-unit.target: 目前等級，從 0（空）到 4（強）。

trans-unit.source: Requirements to check. Strength is the share of rules met, spread over four steps.

trans-unit.source: Arc phone input: a phone field with a country picker. The number formats as it is typed in the selected country's shape (separators only print while digits follow, a typed trunk prefix is kept) with a faint guide showing the rest of the expected number; the value comes out in E.164. The flag button grows into a searchable country list (one morphing surface), pasted or autofilled international numbers pick their own country (+1 picks Canada by area code), and typing "+" in the number jumps into the picker with a calling-code search. After blur an incomplete or too long number shows "Numbers in United Kingdom have 10 digits" unless `IsValidationEnabled` is off or an `ErrorMessage` replaces it; a valid number shows a check. Keyboard: on the country button ArrowDown / ArrowUp open the list and a printable key opens it seeded with that key; in the search ArrowDown / ArrowUp, PageDown / PageUp (8 rows), Home / End (with an empty search) move, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns to the button, Tab closes. In the number, Backspace / Delete on a separator delete the digit beside it.
trans-unit.target: Arc 電話輸入框：帶國家選擇器的電話欄位。號碼會依所選國家的格式邊輸入邊排版（分隔符僅在後面有數字時才顯示，輸入的國內長途前綴會保留），並以淡色提示顯示預期號碼的其餘部分；值以 E.164 格式輸出。國旗按鈕會展開為可搜尋的國家清單（同一個變形面板）；貼上或自動填入的國際號碼會自動選取對應國家（+1 依區碼選取加拿大）；在號碼中輸入 "+" 會跳至選擇器並以國際區號搜尋。失去焦點後，不完整或過長的號碼會顯示 "英國號碼應為 10 位數字"，除非關閉了 `IsValidationEnabled` 或被 `ErrorMessage` 取代；有效號碼會顯示勾號。鍵盤操作：在國家按鈕上，ArrowDown / ArrowUp 開啟清單，可列印字元鍵會開啟清單並以該字元作為搜尋初始值；在搜尋框中，ArrowDown / ArrowUp、PageDown / PageUp（8 列）、Home / End（搜尋框為空時）可移動，Enter 選取，Escape 關閉並回到按鈕，Tab 關閉。在號碼中，在分隔符上按 Backspace / Delete 會刪除其旁邊的數字。

trans-unit.source: A small surface anchored to a trigger and opened by a click, for interactive content that should not block the page: share settings, a small filter form, a picker built from your own controls. Two ways to use it: Code can open any content anchored to any control with `ShowAt`. The panel starts 5px toward its trigger at scale 0.97, fades in fast and settles on a spring from the side it actually landed on; it leaves in about 160ms at half the travel, and an open and a close reverse each other mid-flight. Escape and a press outside close it and return focus to the trigger; focus moves into the panel on open. The trigger answers presses with color only (no press scale), since the panel is measured against it.
trans-unit.target: 一個錨定在觸發器上、由點擊開啟的小型浮層，適用於不應阻擋頁面的互動內容：分享設定、小型篩選表單、由您自己的控制項組成的選取器。有兩種用法：程式碼可透過 `ShowAt` 將任意內容錨定到任意控制項上開啟。面板從觸發器方向偏移 5px 開始，縮放比例為 0.97，快速淡入並以彈簧從實際落位的一側穩定下來；關閉時約 160ms 內完成，移動距離為一半，且開啟與關閉在過程中可相互反轉。按下 Escape 或在外部按下會關閉面板，並將焦點返回觸發器；開啟時焦點會移入面板。觸發器僅以顏色回應按下（無按壓縮放），因為面板是相對於它量測的。

trans-unit.target: 沿觸發器邊緣的對齊方式（預設 Start）。

trans-unit.source: Shows how much of a known task is complete (Arc Progress). One smooth spring drives both the fill and the counted percentage, so the number always matches the bar; the fill slides in from the left (keeping its round end) and turns to the success color at 100%, where a check settles in beside the count. `Minimum` is treated as 0 like Arc; a non-positive `Maximum` counts as 100.
trans-unit.target: 顯示已知任務的完成進度（Arc 進度條）。同一個平滑彈簧同時驅動填滿與計數百分比，因此數字始終與進度條一致；填滿從左側滑入（保留圓形末端），達到 100% 時變為成功色，同時一個勾號在計數旁彈入定位。`Minimum` 與 Arc 相同，視為 0；非正數的 `Maximum` 按 100 計算。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsComplete` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IsComplete` 屬性。

trans-unit.target: 進度條上方的可見標籤；同時也是無障礙名稱（預設為 "Progress"）。

trans-unit.source: A compact sprint board: a few stages as columns, each task a card that the arrow buttons send one stage left or right, a sprint line that fills as tasks reach the finished stage, a team row, an All work / My work switch and an Add button. A moved card flies in a straight line to the end of its new column while the old column closes up; filtered cards fade out in place as the others close the gap. Everything works with Tab, Enter and Space, and screen readers hear each move. Sized for tens of tasks; for hundreds, drag and drop and virtualization, use a full kanban board.

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of prompt caching. Up to four requests share a prompt prefix (tool schemas, instructions, documents, the chat so far) and add a new message each. The first processes every segment in one steady sweep and carries the prefix into the cache panel, where a time-to-live ring fills; later requests read the prefix back under one passing band and only process their message, and their processed tokens, input cost and first-token time roll down from the row above. A toggle edits one segment: the next request matches the cache only up to it, shows a break there and writes the rest again. When no request arrives the ring drains on an accelerated clock and the cache expires; then the round starts over. The totals roll into the input cost saved and the first-token speedup. Costs and times are computed from `Pricing` and `FirstTokenEstimator`; the numbers are illustrative.
trans-unit.target: 提示快取的動畫講解。最多四個請求共享一段提示前綴（工具架構、指令、文件、至今的對話），並各自加入一則新訊息。第一個請求以穩定的一次掃過處理每個段落，並將前綴帶入快取面板，其中的存活時間環逐漸填滿；後續請求在一條掠過的光帶下讀回前綴，只處理它們的訊息，而它們處理的 token、輸入成本與第一個 token 時間會從上一列向下滾入。切換開關可編輯一個段落：下一個請求只會比對到該段落為止的快取，在那裡顯示斷點，並重新寫入其餘部分。若沒有請求到達，存活時間環會以加速的時鐘排空，快取隨之過期；然後整輪重新開始。合計數值彙總為節省的輸入成本與第一個 token 加速比。成本與時間由 `Pricing` 與 `FirstTokenEstimator` 計算；數字僅為示意。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `PromptCache` shows or speaks, in English by default. Replace the instance (or set only the members you need) to translate or reword; sentences with values are functions so their word order can change. trans-unit.source: Arc reactions: a bar of reaction pills with counts plus an add button that opens a compact picker, like Slack's reactions on a comment, post or release note. One tap adds or removes the viewer's reaction: the count rolls (only the digits that change, in the direction it moved), the icon gets a velocity kick that stacks on quick taps (P27), the viewer's own reactions take the accent and a filled glyph. Pills scale in out of a blur and leave the bar when their count reaches zero while the rest glide into place (P26, P19); a new row grows the bar on a spring (P6). Hovering or focusing a pill shows its label and who reacted (`Tooltip`). Keyboard: Enter / Space toggles a pill or opens the picker; in the picker every arrow moves and wraps, Home / End jump, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns focus to the add button. Each change is announced politely.

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of tree search over thoughts (tree of thoughts with beam search). Each depth proposes candidate thoughts as edges draw out of their parents, scores them with bars that fill while the digits count, keeps the best `BeamWidth` and prunes the rest (they fade and their edges retract), and the survivors expand one depth further, up to three. The last depth picks its best thought as the answer, and the winning path draws from the question to the answer with a sheen at its head while each node on it lights up. Play, pause, step and restart drive the story; the beam width control starts it over. Wide cards read left to right in four columns; narrow ones become an indented outline. The scores are illustrative values, not the output of a model.
trans-unit.target: 對思路進行樹搜尋（思路樹加束搜尋）的動畫講解。每個深度會提出候選思路，邊線從其父節點抽出；隨著數字計數，長條逐漸填滿以為其評分；保留最佳的 `BeamWidth` 個並剪枝其餘（它們淡出，邊線收回），倖存者再向下展開一層，最多三層。最後一層選出其最佳思路作為答案，獲勝路徑從問題繪製至答案，光澤位於其頭部，路徑上的每個節點依序亮起。寬卡片從左到右分為四欄閱讀；窄卡片則變為縮排的大綱。播放、暫停、單步與重新開始控制演示過程；束寬控制項會使其重新開始。分數為示意值，並非模型的輸出。

trans-unit.target: `ReasoningTree` 顯示或宣讀的每一個文字，預設為英文：欄標題、標題狀態、束寬標籤、思路的標籤與無障礙名稱，以及即時區域的播報。替換整個實例即可翻譯或改寫；包含數字的句子為函數，以便調整詞序。播放按鈕的名稱由 `PlaybackLabels` 指定。

trans-unit.source: One check of a `ReleaseReadiness` gate: a title, an optional line under it and whether it is done. Every required check must be done before the release can start; optional checks (`IsRequired` false) are shown and can be ticked, but do not hold the release back.
trans-unit.target: `ReleaseReadiness` 關卡中的一個檢查項目：一個標題、標題下方一行可選說明，以及是否已完成。發布開始前，所有必要檢查項目都必須完成；可選檢查項目（`IsRequired` 為 false）會顯示且可勾選，但不會阻擋發布。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title; also read as the checkbox's help text. Null shows the title alone.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行說明，同時也作為核取方塊的說明文字朗讀。為 null 時只顯示標題。

trans-unit.source: Whether the check is done (two-way: ticking the checkbox writes it back).
trans-unit.target: 檢查項目是否已完成（雙向：勾選核取方塊會將其寫回）。

trans-unit.source: The value `Reset` puts back. When it is not set, Reset puts back the value `IsDone` had when the block first showed the check.
trans-unit.target: `Reset` 還原的值。未設定時，Reset 還原區塊首次顯示該檢查項目時 `IsDone` 的值。

trans-unit.source: Whether the release waits for this check (true); an optional check is counted out of the gate and the progress.
trans-unit.target: 發布是否等待此檢查項目（true）；可選檢查項目不計入關卡與進度。

trans-unit.source: A stable id the app can match the check by (events, saved state); null when the check has none.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式可用於比對檢查項目的穩定識別碼（事件、已儲存的狀態）；檢查項目沒有識別碼時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Any object the app wants to keep with the check.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式希望與該檢查項目一同保存的任意物件。

trans-unit.source: The check's title; also the checkbox's name for screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 檢查項目的標題，同時也是核取方塊供螢幕閱讀器朗讀的名稱。

trans-unit.source: A release gate: a few checks that must all be done before the one action unlocks. A header names the release and its owners, a bar fills as checks are ticked (and turns green when every required one is done), a switch chooses whether to notify a channel, and the button runs `ReleaseAction`. While it runs the button shows a spinner and the checks lock; on success the button reads `ReleasedText`, a status line opens under the footer and a reset button appears; on failure the error shows in the same line and the release can be tried again.
trans-unit.target: 發布關卡：若干檢查項目，必須全部完成後才能解鎖唯一的操作。標題列會列出發布名稱及其負責人，進度條隨檢查項目勾選而填滿（所有必要項目完成後變為綠色），開關決定是否通知頻道，按鈕執行 `ReleaseAction`。執行期間按鈕顯示載入指示，檢查項目會被鎖定；成功時按鈕顯示 `ReleasedText`，頁尾下方開啟狀態列，並出現重設按鈕；失敗時錯誤訊息顯示在同一列，且可再次嘗試發布。

trans-unit.source: The word joining the last two owners' names ("and").
trans-unit.target: 連接最後兩位負責人姓名的詞（"and"）。

trans-unit.source: The channel told about the release ("#launches"), used by the switch and the success line.
trans-unit.target: 接收發布通知的頻道（"#launches"），由開關與成功訊息列使用。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a check is ticked or cleared, by the person or by code.
trans-unit.target: 檢查項目被人員或程式碼勾選或取消勾選時引發。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name of the list of checks.
trans-unit.target: 檢查項目清單的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: The checks, when you give them as a list to follow (observed when it raises collection changes); it wins over `Checks`.
trans-unit.target: 檢查項目（當你以清單形式提供並需要追蹤時，會在集合變更時被監看）；優先於 `Checks`。

trans-unit.source: The count on the right of the progress text; {0} is the required checks done, {1} all required checks.
trans-unit.target: 進度文字右側的計數；{0} 為已完成的必要檢查項目數，{1} 為全部必要檢查項目數。

trans-unit.source: How many required checks are done.
trans-unit.target: 已完成的必要檢查項目數量。

trans-unit.source: Turns a failed attempt's exception into the error line; null shows the exception's message.
trans-unit.target: 將失敗嘗試的例外轉換為錯誤訊息列；為 null 時顯示例外的訊息。

trans-unit.source: The error line of the last failed attempt; null unless `State` is Failed.
trans-unit.target: 最近一次失敗嘗試的錯誤訊息列；除非 `State` 為 Failed，否則為 null。

trans-unit.source: The error line when the exception has no message and no `ErrorFormatter` is set.
trans-unit.target: 例外沒有訊息且未設定 `ErrorFormatter` 時的錯誤訊息列。

trans-unit.source: Draws a 560-wide bordered card (true); false lays the block flat on the page at the container's width.
trans-unit.target: 繪製寬 560 的帶框卡片（true）；false 則將區塊平鋪於頁面上，寬度與容器相同。

trans-unit.source: Whether the notify switch is on (two-way). A reset leaves it as it is.
trans-unit.target: 通知開關是否開啟（雙向）。重設不會改變它。

trans-unit.source: Whether the footer shows the notify switch.
trans-unit.target: 頁尾是否顯示通知開關。

trans-unit.source: True when there is at least one check and every required one is done.
trans-unit.target: 至少有一個檢查項目且所有必要檢查項目均已完成時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Whether the reset button appears after a release.
trans-unit.target: 發布後是否顯示重設按鈕。

trans-unit.source: The notify switch's text when `NotifyText` is null; {0} is `ChannelName`.
trans-unit.target: `NotifyText` 為 null 時通知開關的文字；{0} 為 `ChannelName`。

trans-unit.source: The notify switch's text; null formats `NotifyFormat` with `ChannelName`.
trans-unit.target: 通知開關的文字；為 null 時使用 `ChannelName` 依 `NotifyFormat` 格式化。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name of the owners' avatars; null reads `OwnersLabelPrefix` and the names ("Owners: A and B").
trans-unit.target: 負責人頭像的螢幕閱讀器名稱；為 null 時朗讀 `OwnersLabelPrefix` 與姓名（"Owners: A and B"）。

trans-unit.source: Put before the owners' names in their generated screen reader name.
trans-unit.target: 置於產生的螢幕閱讀器名稱中，位於負責人姓名之前。

trans-unit.source: The owners shown as overlapping avatars, when you give them as a list to follow; it wins over `Owners`.
trans-unit.target: 以重疊頭像顯示的負責人（當你以清單形式提供並需要追蹤時）；優先於 `Owners`。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name of the progress bar.
trans-unit.target: 進度條的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `IsReady` changes.
trans-unit.target: `IsReady` 變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: The progress text when every required check is done.
trans-unit.target: 所有必要檢查項目均已完成時的進度文字。

trans-unit.source: Starts the release: awaited when the button is pressed (or `ReleaseAsync` is called) with what the person chose and a token that `CancelRelease` (or the block leaving the window) cancels. An exception fails the attempt and shows its message; a cancellation returns the gate to ready without an error. Null releases at once.
trans-unit.target: 開始發布：按下按鈕（或呼叫 `ReleaseAsync`）時會等待執行，並傳入人員所選的內容以及一個權杖，該權杖可由 `CancelRelease`（或區塊離開視窗）取消。例外會使本次嘗試失敗並顯示其訊息；取消則使關卡回到就緒狀態且不報錯。為 null 時立即發布。

trans-unit.source: Run when a release starts, with the `ReleaseRequest` as the parameter, before `ReleaseAction`; when it cannot execute the release does not start.
trans-unit.target: 發布開始時執行，並以 `ReleaseRequest` 作為參數，且先於 `ReleaseAction` 執行；無法執行時，發布不會開始。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the release action or command threw.
trans-unit.target: 發布操作或命令擲出例外時引發。

trans-unit.source: The release's name in the success line; null uses `Title`.
trans-unit.target: 成功訊息列中的發布名稱；為 null 時使用 `Title`。

trans-unit.source: Raised before a release runs; setting `Cancel` keeps it from starting.
trans-unit.target: 發布執行之前引發；設定 `Cancel` 可阻止其開始。

trans-unit.source: The release button's text before the release (an arrow follows it).
trans-unit.target: 發布之前發布按鈕的文字（後面接一個箭頭）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the release action finished without an error.
trans-unit.target: 發布操作未發生錯誤即完成時引發。

trans-unit.source: The release button's text once the release started (a check mark leads it).
trans-unit.target: 發布開始後發布按鈕的文字（前面帶一個勾號）。

trans-unit.source: The progress text from the moment the release starts until a reset.
trans-unit.target: 從發布開始到重設為止的進度文字。

trans-unit.source: The progress text while more than one required check is open; {0} is how many.
trans-unit.target: 有多個必要檢查項目未完成時的進度文字；{0} 為未完成的數量。

trans-unit.source: The progress text while one required check is open.
trans-unit.target: 有一個必要檢查項目未完成時的進度文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised after `Reset` put the checks back.
trans-unit.target: `Reset` 還原檢查項目後引發。

trans-unit.source: The text of the button that appears after a release and puts the checks back.
trans-unit.target: 發布後出現、用於還原檢查項目的按鈕文字。

trans-unit.source: Where the gate stands.
trans-unit.target: 關卡目前所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `State` changes.
trans-unit.target: `State` 變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: The line shown under the footer (the success or the error line); null while it is closed.
trans-unit.target: 頁尾下方顯示的一列（成功或錯誤訊息列）；關閉時為 null。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading (where and when it ships); null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行（發布的地點與時間）；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The success line when nobody was notified; {0} is the release's name.
trans-unit.target: 無人收到通知時的成功訊息列；{0} 為發布名稱。

trans-unit.source: The success line when the channel was notified; {0} is the release's name, {1} the channel.
trans-unit.target: 已通知頻道時的成功訊息列；{0} 為發布名稱，{1} 為頻道。

trans-unit.source: The heading (the release's name, a version); null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 標題（發布名稱、版本號）；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: How many checks are required (optional ones are not counted).
trans-unit.target: 需要完成的檢查項目數量（不計可選檢查項目）。

trans-unit.source: Where a `ReleaseReadiness` gate stands.
trans-unit.target: `ReleaseReadiness` 關卡所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: What a release attempt was started with: passed to the release action, the command and the events.
trans-unit.target: 發布嘗試啟動時所用的內容：傳遞給發布操作、命令與事件。

trans-unit.source: Arc's reorderable list: organize items with direct drag and drop. Rows are dragged by their grip (pointer capture): the row lifts, follows the pointer, the rows it passes slide aside on springs and the drop settles on a quick spring with the release velocity; holding a row near the edge of a scrolling ancestor scrolls it. Keyboard: ↑/↓ on a grip moves the row one place at once (Arc), Space / Enter picks it up so arrows preview the move, Space / Enter drops it and Escape cancels; every step is announced. A mutable `ItemsSource` (or inline items) is reordered in place; `Reordered` reports each move. Drag motion is render transforms only.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可重新排序清單：透過直接拖放整理項目。列透過抓手拖曳（指標擷取）：列會抬起並跟隨指標，經過的列會以彈簧滑開，放開時以快速彈簧結合放開速度落定；將列按住在捲動祖先的邊緣附近會捲動它。鍵盤操作：抓手上的 ↑/↓ 會立即將該列移動一位（與 Arc 一致），Space / Enter 拾起該列，此時方向鍵可預覽移動，Space / Enter 放下，Escape 取消；每一步都會被通報。可變的 `ItemsSource`（或內嵌項目）會就地重新排序；`Reordered` 回報每次移動。拖曳動態效果僅使用渲染變換。

trans-unit.source: Title used in the grip's accessible name and in announcements (defaults to `Title` or the item text).
trans-unit.target: 用於抓手無障礙名稱與通報的標題（預設為 `Title` 或項目文字）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the list.
trans-unit.target: 清單的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: When true (default) a mutable source is reordered in place; otherwise only `Reordered` is raised.
trans-unit.target: 為 true（預設）時，可變的資料來源會就地重新排序；否則僅引發 `Reordered`。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a row was moved by dragging or from the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 透過拖曳或鍵盤移動某一列之後引發。

trans-unit.source: A row of a `ReorderableList` as Arc models it: an id, a title and an optional detail line.
trans-unit.target: Arc 建模的 `ReorderableList` 中的一列：包含一個 id、一個標題，以及一個可選的詳細資訊行。

trans-unit.source: Fails an empty value (null, empty text).
trans-unit.target: 空值（null、空文字）不通過。

trans-unit.source: One pane of a `ResizablePanels` group. It carries the pane's configuration (label, default share, limits, collapsibility) and shows its content. Below its minimum the content keeps its minimum width, stays anchored to the moving edge and fades, so a closing pane slides away like a drawer instead of being crushed.
trans-unit.target: `ResizablePanels` 群組中的一個窗格。它承載窗格的設定（標籤、預設比例、限制、是否可摺疊）並顯示其內容。低於最小尺寸時，內容保持最小寬度，錨定在移動的邊緣並淡出，因此關閉中的窗格會像抽屜一樣滑走，而不是被壓扁。

trans-unit.source: Starting share of the group; shares are relative and need not add up to 100.
trans-unit.target: 群組的起始比例；比例為相對值，不必加總為 100。

trans-unit.source: Stable id (dividers reference panes by id).
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id（分隔線透過 id 參照窗格）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the pane is hidden. Two-way; the initial value is Arc's defaultCollapsed (needs `IsCollapsible`).
trans-unit.target: 窗格是否已隱藏。雙向繫結；初始值取 Arc 的 defaultCollapsed（需要 `IsCollapsible`）。

trans-unit.source: Dragging well past the minimum, or flicking toward the edge, snaps the pane closed.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳明顯超過最小尺寸，或朝邊緣快速輕掃時，窗格會吸附關閉。

trans-unit.source: Names the pane for its divider, for example "Folders".
trans-unit.target: 為分隔線標示此窗格的名稱，例如 "Folders"。

trans-unit.source: Maximum width in px (infinite by default).
trans-unit.target: 最大寬度，單位為 px（預設無限制）。

trans-unit.source: Width in px where the pane starts to resist (Arc: 80). Its content never reflows below it.
trans-unit.target: 窗格開始產生阻力的寬度，單位為 px（Arc 為 80）。低於此寬度時內容不會重新排版。

trans-unit.source: Arc resizable panels: a horizontal split view whose panes trade space when the dividers between them are dragged, the way a mail or code editor window works. Dividers follow the pointer 1:1, resist past a pane's limits (rubber band up to 44px) and snap collapsible panes closed when dragged well past their minimum or flicked toward the edge; on release the panes settle on the smooth spring keeping the pointer's velocity. Each divider is focusable: arrows resize by 16px (Shift 64px) on the snappy spring, Home / End jump to the limits, Enter hides or restores a collapsible neighbour, Escape during a drag puts the divider back, and a double-click resets the layout. The group needs a definite height. `Sizes` (two-way, percent) persists the layout.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可調整大小的窗格：水平分割檢視，拖曳其間的分隔線時窗格之間相互讓出空間，與郵件或程式碼編輯器視窗的方式相同。分隔線以 1:1 緊隨指標，超出窗格限制時產生回彈（最多 44px）；拖到明顯超過最小尺寸，或朝邊緣快速輕掃時，可摺疊窗格會吸附關閉。放開後，窗格會以保留指標速度的平滑彈簧穩定下來。每條分隔線都可取得焦點：方向鍵每次調整 16px（按住 Shift 為 64px），使用靈敏彈簧；Home / End 跳到限制位置；Enter 隱藏或還原可摺疊的相鄰窗格；拖曳過程中按 Escape 會將分隔線復位；雙擊會重設版面配置。此群組需要確定的高度。`Sizes`（雙向，百分比）用於儲存版面配置。

trans-unit.source: Names the group for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 為此群組命名，供輔助技術使用。

trans-unit.source: Raised with each pane's share in percent after a resize settles.
trans-unit.target: 調整大小完成並穩定後引發，附帶每個窗格的比例（百分比）。

trans-unit.source: Each pane's share in percent. Updated after every resize settles; set it (for example from saved settings) to restore a layout. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 每個窗格的比例（百分比）。每次調整大小完成後更新；設定它（例如從儲存的設定中讀取）即可還原版面配置。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: A city on a `RevenueGlobe`: where payments come from (and, for `Headquarters`, where they go). Coordinates are in degrees; the city's local time uses `UtcOffsetHours`.
trans-unit.target: `RevenueGlobe` 上的城市：付款從這裡發出（對於 `Headquarters`，則是付款的去向）。座標以度為單位；城市的當地時間由 `UtcOffsetHours` 決定。

trans-unit.source: A short country code shown after the name in the list of top cities ("US").
trans-unit.target: 國家代碼的簡寫，顯示在熱門城市清單中城市名稱之後（例如 "US"）。

trans-unit.source: Identifies the city; `CityKey` refers to it.
trans-unit.target: 標識該城市；`CityKey` 會指向它。

trans-unit.source: Latitude in degrees, north positive.
trans-unit.target: 緯度，以度為單位，北緯為正。

trans-unit.source: Longitude in degrees, east positive.
trans-unit.target: 經度，以度為單位，東經為正。

trans-unit.source: The name shown on the globe, in the hover card and in the list of top cities.
trans-unit.target: 在地球、提示卡和熱門城市清單中顯示的名稱。

trans-unit.source: The `Key` of the region the city counts toward.
trans-unit.target: 城市所計入區域的 `Key`。

trans-unit.source: Offset of the city's local time from UTC in hours (5.5 for India); the hover card shows the local time.
trans-unit.target: 城市當地時間相對 UTC 的時差，以小時計（印度為 5.5）；提示卡會顯示當地時間。

trans-unit.source: A relative size for sample data generators; the control itself does not read it.
trans-unit.target: 相對大小，供範例資料產生器使用；控制項本身不會讀取此值。

trans-unit.source: A live payments map: a dotted globe on which every payment flies as an arc from its city to the headquarters, a day timeline under it (payments per 15 minutes, the playhead, replay and live controls), and a panel with today's revenue, the regions against their forecast and the top cities. Drag the globe to spin it (it glides and drifts back and forth when idle), hover a city for its figures, pick a city or a region to fly there, replay the day at 1500× or drag the playhead to any moment; every figure follows the playhead.
trans-unit.target: 即時付款地圖：地球上的每筆付款都會以弧線從其城市飛向總部，地球下方是一條全天時間軸（每 15 分鐘的付款筆數、播放頭、重播與即時控制項），另有一面板顯示今日營收、各區域相對預測的情況以及熱門城市。拖曳地球可使其旋轉（放開後會滑行，閒置時會來回飄移）；懸停城市可查看其數據；選取城市或區域即可飛至該處；可以 1500× 的速度重播當天，或拖曳播放頭至任一時刻；所有數字都會隨播放頭變動。

trans-unit.source: Latitude the camera looks from, in degrees (follows the camera).
trans-unit.target: 相機所望向的緯度，以度為單位（隨相機變化）。

trans-unit.source: Longitude at the center of the view, in degrees (follows the camera).

trans-unit.source: Arc's light rich text editor: Markdown shortcuts as you type, a floating selection toolbar that morphs into a link field, a slash menu for blocks, its own undo history, and HTML plus Markdown output. trans-unit.source: A ridgeline (joy plot, Arc "Ridgeline"): one smoothed density curve per group, overlapping like ridges and shaded by median. Every curve is sampled on a shared 96-point grid, so a new dataset or domain morphs each ridge from its on-screen shape on one 0.7s spring; the first view rolls the rows in from the top. Hover or ↑ / ↓ lifts a ridge (a copy drawn above the rest) with its middle half and median; ← / → move a reading cursor along the values.
trans-unit.target: 山脊圖（joy plot，即 Arc 的 "Ridgeline"）：每組一條平滑的密度曲線，像山脊般相互重疊，並依中位數著色。所有曲線都在共享的 96 點網格上取樣，因此新的資料集或取值範圍會透過一個 0.7s 的彈簧，使每條山脊從目前螢幕形狀變形過渡；首次顯示時各列會從頂部滾入。懸停或按 ↑ / ↓ 可抬起一條山脊（在其他山脊上方繪製一份副本），並顯示其中間一半與中位數；← / → 沿數值移動讀數游標。

trans-unit.source: Arc scroll area: native scrolling (wheel, keyboard, touch inertia, snap points) with thin overlay scrollbars that appear while scrolling or hovering and fade away at rest, and edge fades that appear only where content continues, each exactly as long as the content hidden past that edge (up to `FadeLength`). The thumb thickens under the pointer, can be dragged, and pressing the track pages toward the pointer.
trans-unit.target: Arc 捲動區域：原生捲動（滾輪、鍵盤、觸控慣性、貼齊點），搭配細窄的覆蓋式捲軸，捲動或懸停時出現、靜止時淡出；邊緣淡出僅在內容仍延伸處出現，每段淡出的長度與該邊緣之外被隱藏的內容相符（上限為 `FadeLength`）。捲軸滑塊在指標下會變粗、可拖曳，按下軌道會朝指標方向翻頁。

trans-unit.source: Arc's Scrub input: a compact, Figma-style number field for inspectors and property panels. Drag the label sideways to scrub the value (Shift ten times coarser, Alt ten times finer, switching live and shown in a tag above the field), or click in and type an exact value: entries accept arithmetic such as `12*2` or `(100-24)/2` and a unit from `Units` such as `50%` (see `ScrubExpression`). Arrow keys step, Enter commits, Escape restores the last value, and a double click on the label restores `ResetValue`. At `Minimum` and `Maximum` the field strains past the limit with rubber band resistance and springs back on release; a rejected entry shakes and turns the edge red for 900ms. The row has no label or message rows of its own (the label is the drag handle) and fills its column by default.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的 Scrub 輸入框：緊湊的 Figma 風格數字欄位，適用於檢查器與屬性面板。橫向拖曳標籤即可調整數值（按住 Shift 時粗 10 倍，按住 Alt 時細 10 倍，切換時即時生效，並在欄位上方的提示中顯示），也可點入後輸入精確值：輸入內容支援 `12*2` 或 `(100-24)/2` 等算術運算式，以及 `Units` 中的單位，例如 `50%`（參見 `ScrubExpression`）。方向鍵逐步調整，Enter 提交，Escape 還原上一個值，雙擊標籤會還原 `ResetValue`。到達 `Minimum` 與 `Maximum` 時，欄位會以橡皮筋式阻力越過限制，放開後彈回；被拒絕的輸入會晃動，並將邊緣變紅 900ms。此列本身沒有標籤或訊息列（標籤即拖曳把手），預設填滿其所在欄。

trans-unit.source: Step with Shift held (null: ten times `Step`).
trans-unit.target: 按住 Shift 時的步進值（null：為 `Step` 的 10 倍）。

trans-unit.source: Step with Alt held (null: a tenth of `Step`).
trans-unit.target: 按住 Alt 時的步進值（null：為 `Step` 的十分之一）。

trans-unit.source: True for 900ms after a rejected entry.
trans-unit.target: 輸入被拒絕後的 900ms 內為 true。

trans-unit.source: Arc's `pointerLock`, kept for API parity (default true). Avalonia has no pointer lock, so scrubbing always uses normal pointer capture, as Arc does when a browser refuses the lock: a long drag can reach the screen edge.
trans-unit.target: 對應 Arc 的 `pointerLock`，僅為維持 API 一致而保留（預設為 true）。Avalonia 沒有指標鎖定，因此調整數值時一律使用一般的指標擷取，與瀏覽器拒絕鎖定時 Arc 的做法相同：長距離拖曳可能會到達螢幕邊緣。

trans-unit.source: True while the label is being dragged.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳標籤期間為 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value's position between the limits as a quiet wash (null: on when both limits are finite).
trans-unit.target: 以柔和的底色顯示數值在上下限之間的位置（null：兩個上下限皆為有限值時顯示）。

trans-unit.source: Values wrap from the maximum to the minimum instead of stopping (needs both limits, Maximum > Minimum).
trans-unit.target: 數值從最大值回繞到最小值，而不是停止（需要兩個上下限，且 Maximum > Minimum）。

trans-unit.source: The label, which is also the drag handle: text (weight 500) or a control such as a 14px `ArcGlyph`.
trans-unit.target: 標籤，同時也是拖曳把手：文字（字重 500）或控制項，例如 14px 的 `ArcGlyph`。

trans-unit.source: Upper limit (default positive infinity: none).
trans-unit.target: 上限（預設為正無窮：無上限）。

trans-unit.target: 下限（預設為負無窮：無下限）。

trans-unit.source: Small (30px, 12px text) or Medium (36px, 14px text, default). Arc has no large size: Large renders as Medium.
